shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma skyed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /dor ba skyed pa stong pa nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma 18—351

yin / chos thams cad stong pa nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do / /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ rang gi mtshan ①nyid stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do / /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do//myi dmigs pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /dngos po skyed pa stong pa nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid 18—352

las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa skyed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa med do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ①chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa 18—353

rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ yang dag par spong ba rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /dbang po rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/dbang po rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /18—354

dbang po rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/dbang po rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /dbang po rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ dbang po rnams kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /stobs rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/stobs rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /stobs rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ stobs rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /stobs rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ stobs rnams kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i ①de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i ②de 18—355

bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa med do/ / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i ①chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i ②chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /②'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa ma yin/ bsam gtan rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ bsam gtan rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ bsam gtan rnams kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ tshad myed pa rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa med do/ /tshad myed pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ tshad myed pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /tshad 18—356

myed pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ tshad myed pa rnams kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do//gzugs med pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa skyed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/rnam par thar pa rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ rnam par thar pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ rnam par thar pa rnams kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa ①rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ mthard kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i 18—357

snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang /smon pa myed pa yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa skyed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin / mngon par shes pa rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ mngon par shes pa rnams kyi 18—358

chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ ting nge 'dzin rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi chos nyid las ①gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/gzungs kyi sgo rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa 18—359

rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ myi 'jigs pa rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang ①shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ / byams pa chen po yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ byams pa chen po las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /byams pa chen po'i de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ byams pa chen po'i de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /byams pa chen po'i chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ byams pa chen po'i chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /②snying rje chen po yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ snying rje chen po las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed 18—360

do/ /snying rje chen po'i de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/snying rje chen po'i de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /snying rje chen po'i chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/snying rje chen po'i chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do//sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ thams cad shes pa nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do / /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do//lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma 18—361

yin / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi de bzhin nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi chos nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi chos nyid las gud na yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myed do// //①shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu gsum ②pa / de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis gnas brtan rab 'byord la 'di skad ces smras so/ /btsun pa rab 'byord byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di ni che ba ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa'o/ /btsun pa rab 'byord byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni tshad ②skyed pa ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /btsun pa rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni dpag tu myed pa ste/du'adi ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /btsun pa rab 'byor byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mtha' yas 18—362

pa ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de la bslabs shing ①rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams kyis ni/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob po/ / 'thob bo/ /thob ②par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams kyis ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob po/ /'thob bo(kye/ /thob par 'gyur rol/ /phyir myi 'ong ba rnams kyis ni phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa rnams kyis ni dgra bcom pa nyid thob bo/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni rang byang chub tu mngon par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par 'tshang rgya'oX / /mngon par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de la bslabs shing ⑤byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ni/ sems can yongs su smin par byas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byas nas/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu ༅mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni che ba ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni tshad ⑦myed pa ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni dpag tu myed pa ste/ ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni mtha' yas pa ste/ 'di 18—363

ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de la bslabs shing ①rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams kyis ni/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams kyis ni/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /phyir myi 'ong ba rnams kyis ni/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa rnams kyis ni/ /dgra bcom pa nyid thob bo/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams kyis ni/ rang byang chub tu ②mngon par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par 'tshang rgya'odu/ /mngon par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /de la bslabs shing dubyang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ni sems can yongs su smin par byas/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag par byas nas/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o⑤/ /mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas par 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka gzugs rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs kyi 0sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka tshor ba rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshor ba'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'du shes rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu 18—364

phyin pa 'di rgya ①che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ②'du shes kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'du byed rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'du byed kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam par shes pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka myig rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rna ba rgya che ba'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya niche ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sna rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i dumatha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lce rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i 18—365

phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lus rgya che ba'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka yid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka gzugs rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sgra rgya che ba'i phyir/byang chub sems ①dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sgra'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka dri rgya ②che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dri'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka ro rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ro'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' 18—366

ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar nang stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so//kau shi ka phyi stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar phyi stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka phyi nang stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka stong pa nyid stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka chen po stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chen po stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka don dam pa stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'dus byas stong 18—375

pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs / dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs / phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rang bzhin stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 18—376

'di ltar ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs / dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dngos po skyed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs / phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag pa'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka yang dag par spong ba rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yang dag par spong ba'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs / dbus mi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rgya che ba'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ①ltar rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka dbang po rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dbang po'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka stobs rgya che ba'i 18—378
