dmigs/ dbus myi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam par thar pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ko shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug ①pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa rgya ②che ba'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma skyed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus myi dmyigs so//kau shi ka mngon par shes pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' ③chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mngon dupar shes pa'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/18—380

phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmigs/ dbus myi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka ting nge 'dzin rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ting nge 'dzin kyi sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmigs/dbus myi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka gzungs kyi sgo rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzungs kyi sgo'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs kyi sngon ①gyi mtha' myi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka mi 'jigs pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mi 'jigs pa'i sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmyigs / dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka so so yang dag par rig pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar so so yang dag par rig pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmyigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka snying rje chen po rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/18—381

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar snying rje chen po'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmigs / phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmyigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i sngon gyi mtha' myi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' myi dmigs/ dbus myi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka thams cad shes pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar thams cad shes pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi sngon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/ phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid rgya che ba'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di rgya che ba yin te/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi ①sdon gyi mtha' mi dmigs/phyi ma'i mtha' mi dmigs/ dbus mi dmigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des na / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ②rgya che ba ste / 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /rjoko shi ka gzugs tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 18—382

rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs kyi tshad ni dmigs su myed do/ kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su skyed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du gzugs kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su skyed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/gzugs tshad myed do/ /gzugs tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka tshor ba tshad skyed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshor ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du tshor ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ tshor ba tshad myed do/ /tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka 'du shes tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'du shes kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'du shes kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de①/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ 'du shes tshad myed do/ /'du shes tshad med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka 'du byed tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'du byed kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste 18—383

dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'du byed kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir 'du byed tshad myed do/ /'du byed tshad med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ / kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam par shes pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/① nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir rnam par shes pa tshad myed do/ /rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka myig tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du myig gi tshad kyang dmyigs su med de②/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir / myig tshad myed do/ /myig tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rna ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i tshad ni dmigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rna ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i 18—384

phyir/ rna ba tshad myed do/ /rna ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka sna tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed ①do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sna'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad med pa'i phyir/ sna tshad myed do/ /sna tshad myed ②pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka lce tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lce'i tshad kyang dmyigs su skyed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/lce tshad myed do/ /lce tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka lus tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lus kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' ③tshad med pa'i phyir/lus tshad myed do/ /lus tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka yid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad skyed pa ste/ de ci'i 18—385

phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su skyed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du yid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir / yid tshad myed do/ /yid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka gzugs tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do / /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du gzugs kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ gzugs tshad myed do/ /gzugs tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka sgra tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sgra'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do / /kau shi ka de bzhin du sgra'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad med pa'i phyir/ sgra tshad myed do/ /sgra tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka dri tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dri'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dri'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i 18—386

phyir / dri tshad myed do/ /dri ༅tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka ro tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ro'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su skyed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du ro'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ro tshad skyed do/ /ro tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka reg tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar reg gi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du reg gi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/reg tshad myed do/ /reg tshad myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka chos tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chos kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ci nam mkha'i tshad ni dmigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du ②chos kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/chos tshad myed do/ /chos tshad myed pa'i phyir/ skes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /①ka shi ka myig gi rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed 18—387

pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi rnam par shes pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du myig gi rnam par shes pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ myig gi rnam par shes pa tshad myed do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rna ba'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ②tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka sna'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i rnam par shes pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sna'i rnam par shes pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ sna'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka lce'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' 18—388

chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i rnam par shes pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lce'i rnam par shes pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' ①tshad myed pa'i phyir/ lce'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka lus kyi rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa tshad myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa tshad skyed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka yid kyi rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ yid kyi rnam par shes pa tshad myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka myig gi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i 18—389

phyir / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/myig gi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka sna'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do / /kau shi ka de bzhin du sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do//18—390

kau shi ka lce'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa tshad skyed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do//kau shi ka lus kyi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka yid kyi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad med pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir yid kyi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes 18—391

rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyind pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyend kyis tshor ba tshad myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do//kau shi ka rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyend kyis ①tshor ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyend kyis tshor ba tshad myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /ko 18—392

shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de / nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis hu)tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis 0tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi ①pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis ④tshor ba tshad myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis khyatshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis ⑥tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis metshor ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba tshad myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis khyatshor ba tshad myed 18—393

pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis ①tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed de/ kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis zhutshor ba tshad myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis 0tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa tshad myed do// // shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu bzhi pa/dhi ka shi ka sa'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyind pa 'di tshad med pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sa'i khams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sa'i khams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ sa'i khams tshad myed do/ /sa'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka chu'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chu'i khams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam 18—394

mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du chu'i khams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ chu'i khams tshad skyed do/ /chu'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka mye'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mye'i khams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du me'i khams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' ①tshad myed pa'i phyir/ mye'i khams tshad myed do/ /skye'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rlung gi khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rlung gi khams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rlung gi khams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' ②tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rlung gi khams tshad myed do/ /rlung gi khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka nam mkha'i khams tshad skyed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyind pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar nam mkha'i khams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du nam mkha'i khams kyi 18—395

tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ nam mkha'i khams tshad myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam par shes pa'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi tshad kyang ①dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' ②tshad myed pa'i phyir/rnam par shes pa'i khams tshad myed do/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka ma rig pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ma rig pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du ma rig pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ ma rig pa tshad myed do/ /ma rig pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka 'du byed tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'du byed kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'du byed kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed 18—396

pa'i phyir/ 'du byed tshad myed do/ /'du byed tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su skyed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam par shes pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' ①tshod myed pa'i phyir/ rnam par shes pa tshad myed do/ /rnam par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka mying dang gzugs ②tshad med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mying dang gzugs kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du mying dang gzugs kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad skyed pa'i phyir/ mying dang gzugs tshad myed do/ /mying dang gzugs tshad med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka skye mched drug tshad myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar skye mched drug gi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du skye mched drug gi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ skye mched drug tshad myed do/ /18—397

skye mched drug tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni ①'di ltar reg pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du reg pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/reg pa tshad myed do/ /reg pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshor ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du tshor ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ tshor ba tshad myed do/ /tshor ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka sred pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ②rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sred pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myes do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sred pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ sred pa tshad myed do/ /sred pa tshad myed pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad skyed do/ /kau shi ka len pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol 18—398

tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar len pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du len pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ len pa tshad myed do/ /len pa tshad med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka srid pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar srid pa'i tshad ni dmigs su skyed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na / nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du srid pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad skyed pa'i phyir/ srid pa tshad myed do/ /srid pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka skye ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar skye ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su skyed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du skye ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su skyed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/skye ba tshad myed do/ /skye ba tshad skyed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rga shi tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rga shi'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 18—399

de bzhin du rga shi'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rga shi tshad myed do/ /rga shi tshad skyed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad skyed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do①/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad kyang ②dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' ②tshad myed pa'i phyir/sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do / /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de / nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste 18—400

dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa tshad skyed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do//kau shi ka brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ / kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems 18—401

dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad skyed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /①ka shi ka nang stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar nang stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du nang stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ nang stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /nang stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka phyi stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar phyi stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du phyi stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' ②tshad myed pa'i phyir/ phyi stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka phyi nang stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub 18—402

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ phyi nang stong pa nyid tshad med do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka stong pa nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid tshad med pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka chen po stong pa nyid tshad med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chen po stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du chen po stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang ①dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/chen po stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka don dam pa stong pa nyid 18—403

tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ kau shi ka de bzhin du don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su skyed de/ nam mkha' ༅tshad skyed pa'i phyir/ don dam pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka 'dus byas stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do / /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab 18—404

kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do//mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid tshad med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmigs su myed do①/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du thog ma dang tha ma ②skyed pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do / /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na / nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dor ba 18—405

myed pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rang bzhin stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ②tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su skyed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su med do / /kau shi ka de bzhin du rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de / nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka chos thams cad stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad skyed pa'i phyir/chos thams cad stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs 18—406

su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ①phyi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad ①kyang dmyigs su myed do①/ /nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha 18—407

rold tu phyind pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi tshad ni ①dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do②/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dngos po med pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka dran pa nye bar gzhag pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su skyed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa tshad myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/18—408

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka yang dag par spong ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' ①tshad myed pa'i phyir/ yang dag par spong ba tshad myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba tshad med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau ②shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa tshad med do③/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa tshad med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad med do/ /kau shi ka dbang po tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dbang po rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dbang po rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' butshad myed pa'i phyir/ dbang po tshad myed do/ /dbang po tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab 18—409

kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /ko shi ka stobs tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar stobs rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du stobs rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ stobs tshad myed do/ /stobs tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka byang chub kyi yan lag tshad med pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyis ②tshad ni dmyigs su myed do / /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub kyi yan lag tshad myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do//kau shi ka 'phags pa'i lam ②yan lag brgyad pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa tshad myed do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan 18—410

lag brgyad pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka 'phags pa'i bden pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i bden pa tshad myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka bsam gtan tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du bsam gtan rnams kyi ②tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/bsam gtan tshad myed do/ /bsam gtan tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka byams pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar byams pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du byams pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de / nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir byams pa ②tshad myed do/ /byams pa ⑧18—411

tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka snying rje tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar snying rje'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /①ska shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha'i tshad ni dmigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du snying rje'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ snying rje tshad myed do / /snying rje tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad med do②/ /kau shi ka dga' ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dga' ba'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dga' ba'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/dga' ba tshad myed do/ /dga' ba tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka btang snyoms tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar btang snyoms kyi ③tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su skyed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du btang snyoms kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ btang snyoms tshad myed do/ ci/btang snyoms tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub 18—412

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad skyed pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa tshad myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau ①shi ka rnam par thar pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam par thar pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rnam par thar pa tshad myed do/ /rnam par thar pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka mthar kyis ②gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/18—413

mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa tshad myed do/ /mthar kyis ①gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa ②dang / smon pa myed pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma skyed pa dang /smon pa myed pa'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad med pa'i phyir/rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa tshad myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka mngon par shes pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mngon par shes pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su skyed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du mngon par shes pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad skyed pa'i phyir/ mngon par shes pa tshad myed do/ /mngon par shes pa tshad skyed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka ting nge 'dzin tshad myed pa'i phyir/18—414

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su skyed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su skyed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ ting nge 'dzin tshad myed do/ ting nge 'dzin tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka gzungs kyi sgo tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ gzungs kyi sgo tshad myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs ①tshod myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du ②de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs tshad myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /18—415

kau shi ka myi 'jigs pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myi 'jigs ①pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do / /kau shi ka de bzhin du myi 'jigs ②pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ myi 'jigs pa tshad myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka so so yang dag par rig pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ so so yang dag par rig pa tshad myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa tshad myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka snying rje chen po tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar snying rje chen po'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du snying rje chen po'i tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ snying rje chen po tshad myed do/ /snying rje chen po tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu 18—416

phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa tshad myed pa'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad skyed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa tshad myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka thams cad shes pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar thams cad shes pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du thams cad shes pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ thams cad shes pa nyid tshad myed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lam gyi rnam pa ①shes pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad 18—417

med pa'i phyir/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid tshad myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshad myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshad ni ①dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha'i tshad ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi tshad kyang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' tshad myed pa'i phyir/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid tshad myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid tshad myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshad myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des na byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ②tshad myed pa ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o// ༅shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bco lnga pa/kau shi ka gzugs dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du gzugs kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir gzugs dpag tu myed do/ /gzugs dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka tshor ba dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi 18—418

pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshor ba'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du tshor ba'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir tshor ba dpag tu myed do/ /tshor ba dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka 'du shes dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'du shes kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'du shes kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir 'du shes dpag tu myed do/ /'du shes dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka 'du byed dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'du byed kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'du byed kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir 'du byed dpag tu myed do/ /'du byed dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de 18—419

ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam par shes pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed do/ /rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka myig dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' ①dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du myig gi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir mig dpag tu myed do//myig dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rna ba dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rna ba'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir rna ba dpag tu myed do/ /rna ba dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka sna dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i dpag pa ni 18—420

dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sna'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir sna dpag tu myed do/ /sna dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka lce dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lce'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir lce dpag tu myed do / /lce dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do//kau shi ka lus dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lus kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir lus dpag tu myed do/ /lus dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka yid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu skyed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du yid kyi dpag pa yang 18—421

dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir yid dpag tu myed do//yid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka gzugs dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du gzugs kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir gzugs dpag tu myed do/ /gzugs dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka sgra dpag tu myed pa'i phyir / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sgra'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sgra'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir sgra dpag tu myed do/ /sgra dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka dri dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dri'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dri'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir dri dpag tu myed do/ /dri dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 18—422

dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka ro dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ro'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do//kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du ro'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir ro dpag tu skyed do/ /ro dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka reg dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar reg gi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di ltar ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du reg gi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir reg dpag tu myed do//reg dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka chos dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chos kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du chos kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir chos dpag tu myed do/ /chos dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka myig gi rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol 18—423

tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi rnam par shes pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du myig gi rnam par shes pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ myig gi rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dpag tu skyed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed do/ /nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka sna'i rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i rnam par shes pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sna'i rnam par shes pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ sna'i rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/18—424

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka lce'i rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i rnam par shes pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lce'i rnam par shes pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed do/ /nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ lce'i rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka lus kyi rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do//kau shi ka yid kyi rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu skyed pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i dpag 18—425

pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu skyed pa'i phyir yid kyi rnam par shes pa dpag tu myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa dpag tu med pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka myig gi 'dus te reg pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa dpag tu myed do//myig gi 'dus te reg pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na / nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dpag tu myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka sna'i 'dus te reg pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i 'dus te reg 18—426

pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir sna'i 'dus te reg pa dpag tu myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka lce'i 'dus te reg pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i dpag pa ni/dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu skyed pa'i phyir/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa dpag tu myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' dpag tu skyed pa'i phyir/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dpag tu myed do//lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/18—427
