shi ka de ni 'di ltar sa'i khams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sa'i khams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ sa'i khams dpag tu myed do/ /sa'i khams dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka chu'i khams dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chu'i khams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du chu'i khams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ chu'i khams dpag tu myed do/ /chu'i khams dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka mye'i khams dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar me'i khams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du mye'i khams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ mye'i khams dpag tu myed do/ /mye'i khams dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rlung gi khams dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/18—431

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mying dang gzugs kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du mying dang gzugs kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/mying dang gzugs dpag tu myed do/ /mying dang gzugs dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka skye mched drug dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar skye mched drug gi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du skye mched drug gi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ skye mched drug dpag tu myed do/ /skye mched drug dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka reg pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu skyed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar reg pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du reg pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir reg pa dpag tu myed do/ /reg pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka tshor ba dpag tu myed pa'i 18—434

phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar srid pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du srid pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su/ myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir srid pa dpag tu myed do/ /srid pa dpag tu med pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka skye ba dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar skye ba'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du skye ba'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ skye ba dpag tu myed do/ /skye ba dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu skyed do/ /kau shi ka rga shi dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rga shi'i dpag pa ni dmigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rga shi'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir rga shi dpag tu myed do/ /rga shi dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyind pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de 18—436

ni 'di ltar sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sem/sa dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dpa ga pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa mi dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems ngapa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do / /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu skyed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed 18—437

pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su 18—438

myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka nang stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar nang stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du nang stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ nang stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /nang stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka phyi stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar phyi stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du phyi stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su skyed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ phyi stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka phyi nang stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu 18—439

phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ phyi nang stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka chen po stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chen po stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du chen po stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ chen po stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 18—440

dpag tu skyed do/ /kau shi ka don dam pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su skyed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ don dam pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka 'dus byas stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu skyed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs 18—441

su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su skyed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar thog ma dang tha ma skyed pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems 18—442

dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu skyed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su med do/ /ko shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rang bzhin stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /ko shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su med do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dpag tu med pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka chos thams cad stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ chos thams cad 18—443

stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyind pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag 18—444

pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dngos po skyed pa stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /dngos po med pa stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu skyed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su med do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi 18—445

pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dpag tu myed do//dran pa nye bar gzhag pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka yang dag par spong ba dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ yang dag par spong ba dpag tu myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rdzu 'phrul gyi 18—446

rkang pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dpag tu myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka dbang po dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dbang po rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dbang po rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir dbang po dpag tu myed do/ /dbang po dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka stobs dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar stobs rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du stobs rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir stobs dpag tu myed do/ /stobs dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka byang chub kyi yan lag dpag tu skyed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed 18—447

do / /kau shi ka de bzhin du byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub kyi yan lag dpag tu myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su skyed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dpag tu med do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka 'phags pa'i bden pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu med pa'i phyir/ 'phags pa'i bden pa dpag tu med do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka bsam gtan dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub 18—448

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du bsam gtan rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/bsam gtan dpag tu myed do/ /bsam gtan dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka byams pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa ra sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar byams pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du byams pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su skyed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/byams pa dpag tu myed do/ /byams pa dpag tu skyed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka snying rje dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar snying rje'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du snying rje'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu med pa'i phyir snying rje dpag tu myed do/ /snying rje dpag tu med pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu skyed do/ /kau shi ka dga' ba dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' 18—449

sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dga' ba'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du dga' ba'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' dpag tu med pa'i phyir dga' ba dpag tu skyed do/ /dga' ba dpag tu myed pa'i phyir shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu med do/ /kau shi ka btang snyoms dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar btang snyoms kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du btang snyoms kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ btang snyoms dpag tu myed do/ /btang snyoms dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du gzugs skyed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa 18—450

dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam par thar pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam par thar pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ rnam par thar pa dpag tu myed do/ /rnam par thar pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ko shi ka de ni 'di ltar mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau 18—451

shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dpag tu myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma skyed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka mngon par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mngon par shes pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du mngon par shes pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ mngon par shes pa dpag tu myed do/ /mngon par shes pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka ting nge 'dzin dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du ting nge 'dzin 18—452

rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ting nge 'dzin dpag tu myed do/ /ting nge 'dzin dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu med do/ /kau shi ka gzungs kyi sgo dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su skyed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su med do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ gzungs kyi sgo dpag tu myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu med do//kau shi ka de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dpag tu myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka myi 'jigs pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de mi 'di ltar myi 'jigs 18—453

pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ myi 'jigs pa dpag tu myed do/ /myi 'jigs pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka so so yang dag par rig pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ so so yang dag par rig pa dpag tu myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka snying rje chen po dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar snying rje chen po'i dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du snying rje chen po'i dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir snying rje chen po dpag tu myed do/ /snying rje chen po dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ byang chub 18—454

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu skyed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dpag tu myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka thams cad shes pa nyid dpag tu skyed pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar thams cad shes pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du thams cad shes pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ thams cad shes pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/ nam mkha' dpag tu myed 18—455

pa'i phyir/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ nam mkha' dpag pa ni dmyigs su myed do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi dpag pa yang dmyigs su myed de/nam mkha' dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dpag tu myed do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dpag tu myed pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dpag tu myed do/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des na/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dpag tu myed pa ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o// //sa①shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po bcu drug ②pa / kau shi ka gzugs mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so//kau shi ka tshor ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshor ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'du shes mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 18—456

rnams kyi pha rol tu phyind pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'du shes kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'du byed mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'du byed kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka myig mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ①ltar myig gi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rna ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ ci/kau shi ka sna mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lce mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka ②de ni 'di ltar lce'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lus mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i 18—457

phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka yid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka gzugs mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sgra mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sgra'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka dri mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dri'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka ro mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ro'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka reg mtha' yas pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar reg gi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka chos mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chos kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka myig gi 18—458

rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi rnam par shes pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so//kau shi ka rna ba'i rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sna'i rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ①mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i rnam par shes pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lce'i rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i rnam par shes pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lus kyi rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi rnam par shes pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so//kau shi ka yid kyi rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi rnam par shes pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka myig gi 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 18—459

mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sna'i 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lce'i 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lus kyi 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka yid kyi 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ①mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i mtha' dang dbus mi dmyigs so//kau shi ka myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myig gi 'dus te reg 18—460

pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin ①pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyend kyis ༅tshor ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis nitshor ba'i mtha' dang / dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka yid kyi du'adus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis metshor ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis dutshor ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sa'i khams mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 18—461

rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sa'i khams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka chu'i khams mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chu'i khams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka mye'i khams mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mye'i khams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rlung gi khams mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rlung gi ①khams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka nam mkha'i khams mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar nam mkha'i khams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam par shes pa'i khams mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i khams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka ma rig ②pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ma rig pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'du byed mtha' yas pa'i 18—462

phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'du byed kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka mying dang gzugs mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir ①zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mying dang gzugs kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka skye mched drug mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar skye mched drug gi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka reg pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar reg pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka tshor ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshor ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sred pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sred ②pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka len ①pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/18—463

byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar len ①pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka srid pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar srid pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka skye ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar skye ba'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rga shi mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' ②chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rga shi'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bzod pa'i pha 18—464

rol tu phyin pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas ①pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka nang stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar nang stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka phyi stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar phyi stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka phyi nang stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka stong pa nyid 18—465

stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka chen po stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chen po stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka don dam pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'dus byas stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' 18—466

sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rang bzhin stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so//kau shi ka chos thams cad stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 18—467

'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dngos po skyed pa stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka dran pa nye bar gzhag pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka yang dag par spong ba mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka dbang po mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 18—468

'di ltar dbang po rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka stobs mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar stobs rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka byang chub kyi yan lag mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so//kau shi ka 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'phags pa'i ①lam yan lag brgyad pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'phags pa'i bden pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ②ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka bsam gtan mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka tshad myed pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshad myed pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 18—469

'jug pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzugs skyed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam par thar pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka mthard kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka mngon par shes pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mngon par shes pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka ting nge 'dzin mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di 18—470

ltar ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka gzungs kyi sgo mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka myi 'jigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar mi 'jigs pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka so so yang dag par rig pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka byams pa chen po mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar byams pa chen po'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka snying rje chen po mtha' yas pa'i phyir/byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar snying rje chen po'i mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa 18—471

mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka thams cad shes pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar thams cad shes pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka lam gyi rnam pa ①shes pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar lam ②gyi rnam pa ①shes pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi mtha' dang dbus myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des na/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni gzugs mtha' yas pa dang / tshor ba mtha' yas pa dang / 'du shes mtha' yas pa dang / 'du byed mtha' yas pa dang / rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa dang / myig mtha' yas pa dang / rna ba mtha' yas pa dang / sna mtha' yas pa dang / lce mtha' yas pa dang / lus mtha' yas pa dang / yid mtha' yas pa dang /gzugs mtha' yas pa dang / sgra mtha' yas pa dang / dri mtha' yas pa dang /ro mtha' yas pa dang / reg mtha' yas pa dang / chos mtha' yas pa dang /18—472

myig gi rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa dang /yid kyi rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa dang /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa mtha' yas pa dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa dang /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba mtha' yas pa dang / sa'i khams mtha' yas pa dang / chu'i khams mtha' yas pa dang /mye'i khams mtha' yas pa dang / rlung gi khams mtha' yas pa dang / nam mkha'i khams mtha' yas pa dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams mtha' yas pa dang / ma rig pa mtha' yas pa dang / 'du byed mtha' yas pa dang /rnam par shes pa mtha' yas pa dang / mying dang gzugs mtha' yas pa dang /skye mched drug mtha' yas pa dang / reg pa mtha' yas pa dang / tshor ba mtha' yas pa dang / sred pa mtha' yas pa dang / len pa mtha' yas pa dang /srid pa mtha' yas pa dang / skye ba mtha' yas pa dang / rga shi mtha' yas pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha 18—473

rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas pa dang / nang stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang /don dam pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang /rang bzhin stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams mtha' yas pa dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams mtha' yas pa dang /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams mtha' yas pa dang / dbang po rnams mtha' yas pa dang / stobs rnams mtha' yas pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams mtha' yas pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa mtha' yas pa dang /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams mtha' yas pa dang / bsam gtan rnams mtha' yas pa dang / tshad myed pa rnams mtha' yas pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i 18—474

snyoms par 'jug pa rnams mtha' yas pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad mtha' yas pa dang / mthar kyis ①gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu mtha' yas pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa mtha' yas pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams mtha' yas pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams mtha' yas pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams mtha' yas pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ②mtha' yas pa dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi mtha' yas pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi mtha' yas pa dang / byams pa chen po mtha' yas pa dang / snying rje chen po mtha' yas pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa bca brgyad mtha' yas pa dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu mtha' yas pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mtha' yas pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu mtha' yas pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / rang byang chub mtha' yas pa dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid mtha' yas pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir mtha' yas pa ste/ de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /brgya byin kyis smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de rnam pa gang gis na dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin zhes bya/ /rab 'byord kyis smras pa/ kau shi ka rnam pa 18—475

thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang chos dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de rnam pa gang gis na chos dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin zhes bya①/ rab 'byord kyis smras pa/kau shi ka chos kyi dbyings mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang de bzhin nyid dang dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ de ni 'di ltar ③shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de rnam pa gang gis na dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa ste/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin ③zhes bya/ rab 'byord kyis smras pa/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar de bzhin nyid mtha' yas pa'i phyir dmyigs pa mtha' yas soX / /dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ de bzhin nyid mtha' yas so/ /kau dushi ka de bzhin nyid dang dmyigs pa mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub 18—476

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas so//kau shi ka gzhan yang sems can mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas so/ /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de rnam pa gang gis na ①sems can mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mtha' yas pa yin zhes bya/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/ 'di lta ste sems can sems can zhes bya ba de chos gang gi tshig bla dgas yin/ brgya byin gyis smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de ni chos kyi tshig bla dgas kyang ma yin/ chos ma yin pa'i tshig bla dgas kyang ma yin te②/ 'di ltar sems can sems can zhes bya ba 'di ni glo bur du ming du ③btags pa/ dngos po myed par mying du btags pa/ dmyigs pa myed par ming du btags pa'odu/ /rab 'byord kyis smras pa/ kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las khyasems can du bshad pa gang yang yod dam/ brgya byin gyis smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de ni myed do/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ kau shi ka gang la sems can du bshad pa gang yang myed pa de la/ sems can mtha' yas pa khyayod del/ kau shi ka gal te de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas bskal pa gang gā'i niklung gi ⑨bye ma snyed du bzhugs te/ sems can sems can zhes gsung du brjod na/ kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/ de la sems can gang yang skye ba'am/ 'gag par gyur pa ⑩yod dam/ smras pa/ btsun pa rab 'byor de ni myed de⑩/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can thog ma nas rnam par 18—477

dag pa'i phyir ro/ /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ kau shi ka de ltar rnam grangs des na/ sems can mtha' yas pa'i phyir/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtha' yas par rig par bya'o/ /de nas dbang po dang bcas pa'i lha rnams dang tshangs pa dang bcas pa'i lha rnams dang / skye dgu'i ①bdag po dang bcas pa'i lha rnams dang / skyes pa dang bud myed du bcas pa dag gis lan gsum du ched du brjod pa ②ched du brjod de gang gnas brtan rab 'byor gyis 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa 'byung ba'i don du de bzhin gshegs pa'i byin gyi ③rlabs dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i mthus bshad cing brjod de/ bstan pa'i chos 'di ni kye ma legs par bshad do/ /kye ma chos 'di legs par bshad do / /kye ma chos kyi chos nyid ni legs par bshad do/ /bcom ldan 'das rjobadag cag gis byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dang ma bral ba de ni de bzhin gshegs pa nyid du gzung ⑤bar bgyi'o/ /chos gang yang dmyigs su ma mchis te/ gzugs sam/ tshor ba'am/ 'du shes sam/ 'du byed dam/ rnam par shes pa'am/ myig gam/ rna ba'am/ sna'am/ lce'am/ lus sam/ yid dam/gzugs sam/ sgra'am/ dri'am/ ro'am/ reg gam/ chos sam/myig gi rnam par shes pa'am/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'am/ sna'i rnam par shes pa'am/ lce'i rnam par shes pa'am/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa'am/yid kyi rnam par shes pa'am/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'am/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'am/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'am/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'am/lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'am/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'am/ myig gi 'dus 18—478

te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'am/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'am/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba 'am/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'am/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'am/yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'am/ sa'i khams sam/ chu'i khams sam/ mye'i khams sam/ rlung gi khams sam/ nam mkha'i khams sam/ rnam par shes pa'i khams sam/ ma rig pa'am/ 'du byed dam/rnam par shes pa'am/ mying dang gzugs sam/ skye mched drug gam/ reg pa'am/ tshor ba'am/ sred pa'am/ len pa'am/ srid pa'am/ skye ba'am/ rga shi'am/ sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyind pa'am/ tshul khrims kyi pha rold tu phyind pa'am/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'am/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'am/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'am/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'am/ nang stong pa nyid dam/ phyi stong pa nyid dam/ phyi nang stong pa nyid dam/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dam/ chen po stong pa nyid dam/ don dam pa stong pa nyid dam/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid dam/'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dam/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dam/thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dam/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dam/rang bzhin stong pa nyid dam/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid dam/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dam/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dam/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dam/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dam/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dam/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams sam/ yang dag par spong ba rnams sam/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams sam/ dbang po rnams 18—479

sam/ stobs rnams sam/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams sam/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'am/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams sam/ bsam gtan rnams sam/ tshad myed pa rnams sam/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sam/ rnam par thar pa rnams sam/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sam/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma skyed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'am/ mngon par shes pa rnams sam/ ting nge 'dzin rnams sam/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams sam/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams sam/ myi 'jigs pa rnams sam/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams sam/ byams pa chen po'am/ snying rje chen po'am/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sam/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'amanyu/lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid dam⑤/ rang byang chub 'amadu/ thams cad shes pa nyid dam/ lam gyi rnam pa dushes pa nyid dam/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dam/ chos gang yang dmyigs su ma mchis kyis kyang theg pa gsum rnam par dgod pa ⑤mchis te/ gsum gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste nyan thos kyi theg pa dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'o / /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i bu yidabang po dang bcas pa rnams la bka' stsal pa/ lha'i bu dag de ⑦de bzhin no/ ji skad ⑤smras pa de bzhin no / /khyachos gang yang dmyigs su myed de/ gzugs sam/ tshor ba'am / 'du shes sam/ 'du byed dam/ rnam par shes pa'am/ myig gam / rna ba'am/ sna'am/ lce'am/ lus sam/ yid dam/18—480

gzugs sam/ sgra'am/ dri'am/ ro'am/ reg gam/ chos sam/myig gi rnam par shes pa'am/ rna ba'i rnam par shes pa'am/ sna'i rnam par shes pa'am/ lce'i rnam par shes pa'am/ lus kyi rnam par shes pa'am/yid kyi rnam par shes pa'am/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'am/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'am/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'am/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'am/lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'am/ yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'am/ myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'am/ rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'am/ sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'am/ lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'am/ lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'am/yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba'am/ sa'i khams sam/ chu'i khams sam/ mye'i khams sam/ rlung gi khams sam/ nam mkha'i khams sam/ rnam par shes pa'i khams sam/ ma rig pa'am/ 'du byed dam/rnam par shes pa'am/ mying dang gzugs sam/ skye mched drug gam/ reg pa'am/ tshor ba'am/ sred pa'am/ len pa'am/ srid pa 'am/ skye ba'am / rga shi'am/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'am/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'am/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'am/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'am/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyind pa'am/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa'am/ nang stong pa nyid dam/ phyi stong pa nyid dam/phyi nang stong pa nyid dam/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dam/ chen po stong pa nyid dam/ don dam pa stong pa nyid dam/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid dam/'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dam/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dam/18—481

thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dam/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dam/rang bzhin stong pa nyid dam/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid dam/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dam/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dam/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dam/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dam/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dam/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams sam/ yang dag par spong ba rnams sam/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams sam/ dbang po rnams sam/ stobs rnams sam/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams sam/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'am/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams sam/bsam gtan rnams sam/ tshad myed pa rnams sam/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sam/ rnam par thar pa rnams sam/ mthard kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams sam/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'amanyu/ mngon par shes pa rnams sam/ ting nge 'dzin rnams sam/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams sam/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams sam/ myi 'jigs pa rnams sam/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams sam/ byams pa chen po'am/ snying rje chen po'am/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams sam/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu'am/lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu'am/ dgra bcom pa nyid dam/ rang byang chub bamal/ lam gyi rnam pa ①shes pa nyid dam/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid dam/ chos gang yang myi dmyigs mod kyidu/theg pa gsum rnam par dgod ⑤pa yang yod de/ gsum gang zhe na/ nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / bla na myed pa yang 18—482
