ma'i cha'i kun tu sbyor ba lnga spangs pa'i phyir/ dgra bcom par gyur pa ches nyung ngo / /de bas kyang 'dzam bu'i gling gi myi las rang byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs par gyur pa ches nyung ngo / /de bas kyang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs ①par gyur pa ches nyung ngo / /de bas kyang bsam pa ②dag pa ②byang chub tu spyod pa ni ches nyung bar rig par bya'o//kau shi ka myi rnams lta zhog gi/ de ji snyam du sems/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi srog chags rnams las byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu ④ma bdun thob pa dang /rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum thob pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad thob pa dang /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu thob pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob pa dang / mngon par shes pa drug thob pa de lta bu ⑤ni ji snyed cig yod/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi srog chags rnams las kun tu sbyor ba gsum spangs pa'i phyir⑥/ rgyun tu zhugs par gyur pa dang / 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang / gti mug bsrabs ⑦pa'i phyir/ lan cig phyir 'ong bar gyur pa dang / dam pa ma yin pa'i cha'i ⑤kun tu sbyor ba lnga spangs pa'i phyir/phyir myi 'ong bar gyur pa dang / bla ma'i cha'i kun tu sbyor ba lnga spangs pa'i phyir/dgra bcom par gyur pa ⑨dang / rang byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs pa de lta bu ni ji snyed cig yod/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi srog chags rnams las bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la yinem nur myed pa dang / sangs rgyas dang / chos dang / dge 'dun la nem nur myed pa ni ji snyed cig yod/'dzam bu'i gling gi srog chags rnams las 0mar shes pa dang / phar shes pa dang / dge sbyong du shes pa dang / bram zer shes pa dang / rigs kyi gtso 18—583

bo la rim gro ①byed pa dang / sbyin pa sbyin pa dang / tshul khrims srung ②ba dang /chagaso ④phyin la gnas pa dang / 'dod pa la kha na ma tho bar 'du shes shing /rnam par spyod pa dang / de bzhin du myi rtag par 'du shes pa dang / bdag myed par 'du shes pa dang / myi gtsang bar 'du shes pa dang / 'jig rten thams cad du mngon par dga' ba myed par 'du shes pa ni ji snyed cig yod/'dzam bu'i gling gi srog ⑤chags rnams yolas bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs pa ni ji snyed cig yod/ brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'dzam bu'i gling gi srog chags ⑦las byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu 987rtsa bdun thob pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum thob pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad thob pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu thob pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob pa dang / mngon par shes pa drug thob pa dang / kun tu sbyor ba gsum spangs pa'i slad du/ rgyun tu zhugs par gyur pa dang / 'dod chags dang zhe sdang dang / gti mug bslabs ⑨pa'i slad du/ lan cig phyir 'ong bar gyur pa dang / dam pa ma lags pa'i cha'i kun tu sbyor ba lnga spangs pa'i slad du/phyir myi 'ong bar gyur pa dang / bla ma'i cha'i kun tu sbyor ba lnga spangs pa'i slad dul/ dgra bcom par gyur pa dang / rang byang chub tu zhugs pa de lta bu ni shin tu nyung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das 'dzam bu'i gling gi srog chags las bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs pa de lta bu ni de bas kyang ches nyung ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑩bka' su55 pa/ kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ ji skad smras pa de yibazhin te/ kau shi ka 18—584

'dzam bu'i gling gi srog chags las byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu ①ma bdun ②thob pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum thob pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad thob pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu thob pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi thob pa dang / mngon par shes pa drug thob pa dang / kun tu sbyor ba gsum spangs pa'i phyir/ rgyun tu zhugs pa ②thob pa dang / 'dod chags dang / zhe sdang dang / gti mug bslabs ④pa'i phyir/ lan cig phyir 'ong bar gyur pa dang / dam pa ma yin pa'i cha'i kun tu sbyor ba lnga spangs pa'i phyir/ phyir myi 'ong bar gyur pa dang / bla ma'i cha'i kun tu sbyor ba lnga spangs pa'i phyir/ dgra bcom par gyur pa dang / rang byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs pa dang / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs pa de lta bu ni nyung ste/ de bas kyang gang ⑤bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu spyod pa de lta bu ni ches nyung ngo / /de bas kyang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pa de lta bu ni ches nyung ngo / /kau shi ka ngas 'di nas yisangs rgyas kyi spyan bsgribs pa myed pas/ shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams ⑦gang gā'i ⑧klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can tshad myed grangs myed pa bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu spyod kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang myi ldan pas de las ⑨gcig gam gnyis shig phyir myi ldog pa'i sa la gnas par 'gyur gyi/ de las phal cher nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la gnas par 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ⑩ni le lo can/ brtson 18—585

'grus myed pa/ bsam pa zhan ①pa/ mos pa dma' ba/ shes rab 'chal pa can rnams kyis bsgrub ②par dka'o/ /kau shi ka ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan bsgribs pa myed pas/ lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i ③klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can tshad myed grangs myed pa④/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu spyod kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang myi ldan pas/ de las ⑤gcig gam gnyis shig /phyir myi ldog pa'i sa la gnas par 'gyur gyi/ de las phal cher nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la gnas par 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni le lo can/ brtson 'grus myed pa/ bsam pa zhan ༅pa/ mos pa dma' ba/ shes rab 'chal pa can rnams kyis bsgrub ༅par dka'o/ /kau shi ka ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan bsgribs pa myed pas/ nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅga'i duklung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can tshad myed grangs myed pa/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu spyo da kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang / myi ldan pas de las gcig gam gnyis shig phyir myi ldog pa'i sa la gnas par 'gyur gyi/ de las phal cher nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la gnas par 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni le lo can/ brtson 'grus myed pa/ bsam pa zhan pa/ mos pa dma' ba/ shes rab 'chal pa can rnams kyis bsgrub par dka'o/ /kau shi ka ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan bsgribs pa myed pas/ byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i ⑨klung gi bye 18—586

ma snyed dag na/ sems can tshad skyed grangs myed pa/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu spyod kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang myi ldan bas/ de las gcig gam gnyis shig phyir myi ldog pa'i sa la gnas par 'gyur gyi/ de las phal cher nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la gnas par 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni le lo can/ brtson 'grus myed pa/bsam pa zhan pa/ mos pa dma' ba①/ shes rab 'chal pa can rnams kyis bsgrub ②par dka'o/ /kau shi ka ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan bsgribs pa myed pas/ byang shar gyi niphyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i duklung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can tshad myed grangs myed pa/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu spyod kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang myi ldan pas/ de las gcig gam gnyis shig phyir myi ldog pa'i sa la gnas par 'gyur gyi/ de las phal cher nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la gnas par 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni le lo can/ brtson 'grus myed pa/ bsam pa zhan pa/ mos pa dma' ba/ shes rab 'chal pa can rnams kyis bsgrub ⑤par dka'o/ /kau shi ka ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi/spyan bsgribs pa myed pas/ shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i ⑥klung gi ⑦bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can tshad myed grangs myed pa/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu spyod kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang myi ldan pas/ de las gcig gam gnyis 18—587

shig phyir myi ldog pa'i sa la gnas par 'gyur gyi/ de las phal cher nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la gnas par 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni le lo can / brtson 'grus myed pa/ bsam pa zhan pa/ mos pa dma' ba/shes rab 'chal pa can rnams kyis bsgrub par dka'o/ /kau shi ka ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan bsgribs pa myed pas/ lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams ①kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i ②klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can tshad myed grangs myed pa bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu spyod kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang myi ldan pas/ de las ②gcig gam gnyis shig phyir myi ldog pa'i sa la gnas par 'gyur gyi/ de las phal cher nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la gnas par 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka bla na myed pa yang dag par ④rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni le lo can/ brtson 'grus myed pa/ bsam pa zhan pa/ mos pa dma' ba/shes rab 'chal pa can rnams kyis bsgrub par dka'o/ /kau shi ka ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan bsgribs pa myed pas/ nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i ⑤ klung gi ༅bye ma snyed dag na sems can tshad myed grangs myed pa/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu spyod kyang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang myi ldan pas/ de las gcig gam gnyis shig phyir myi ldog pa'i sa la gnas par 'gyur gyi ⑦de las phal cher nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la gnas par 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni 18—588

le lo can/ brtson 'grus myed pa/ bsam pa zhan pa/ mos pa dma' ba/shes rab 'chal pa can rnams kyis bsgrub par dka'o/ /kau shi ka ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan bsgribs pa myed pas/ 'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅga'i ⑨klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can tshad myed grangs myed pa/bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu spyod kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang myi ldan pas/ de las gcig gam gnyis shig phyir myi ldog pa'i sa la gnas par 'gyur gyi/ de las phal cher nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la gnas par 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka bla na myed pa/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni le lo can/ brtson 'grus myed pa/ bsam pa zhan pa/ mos pa dma' ba/shes rab 'chal pa can rnams kyis bsgrub ②par dka'o②/ /kau shi ka ngas 'di nas sangs rgyas kyi spyan bsgribs ④pa myed pas/ steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i ②klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can tshad myed grangs myed pa / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu spyod kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa'i thabs mkhas pa dang myi ldan pas/ de las gcig gam gnyis shig phyir myi ldog pa'i sa la gnas par 'gyur gyi/ de las phal cher nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa la gnas par 'gyur ba mthong ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni le lo can/ brtson 'grus ༷myed pa/ bsam pa zhan pa/ mos pa dma' ba/shes rab 'chal ba can rnams kyis ⑦bsgrub par dka'o/ /kau shi ka de bas na/rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang 18—589

chub tu yang dag par zhugs pa de dag myur zhing / bde bar bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang ①rgya bar 'dod na / yang dang yang du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la mnyan par bya'o/ /gzung bar bya'o/ /bcang bar bya'o/ /klag ②par bya'o/ / kun chub par bya'o / /②tshul bzhin du yid la bya'o/ /de dag gis ④shis rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa 'di gzung zhing / bcang ba dang / klag ⑤cing kun chub pa dang /tshul bzhin du yid la bya zhing 'ubris te/ me tog dang / bdug 0spos dang /phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan mang pos rim gror bya'o/ /bkur stir bya'o/ /phu dud du bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /dge ba'i chos gang ji snyed pa gzhan yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu ⑤phyin pa 'di'i nang du 'dus te/de dag kyang gzung bar bya/ bcang bar bya/ klag ⑨par bya/ kun chub par bya / tshul bzhin du yid la bya ste/ 'di ltar sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang /chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa 18—590

nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang /dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang /bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang /mngon par shes pa lnga dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang /snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad dang /gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad myed pa gang ji snyed/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i nang du 'dus pa de dag kyang gzung bar bya'o/ /bcang bar bya'o//klag ①par bya'o/ /kun chub par bya'o/ /tshul bzhin du ②yid la bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag 'di ltar shes par 'gyur te/ de bzhin gshegs pa sngon byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe yang 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa dang /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyind pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyind 18—591

pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang /chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ①ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang /dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang /bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo gsum dang /mngon par shes pa lnga dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang /snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad po 'di dag dang / gzhan yang sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad myed pa dag la bslab par ②mdzad kyi②ske/ bdag cag gis kyang de'i rjes su bslab par bya'o/ /'di lta ste/18—592

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni bdag cag gi ston pa'o/ /sangs rgyas kyi ①chos gzhan tshad myed pa'i bar du yang bdag cag gi ②ston pa ste/ de ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis bstan pa'o/ /rang sangs rgyas dang /dgra bcom pa dang / phyir myi 'ong ba dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang /rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams kyis bstan pa yang 'di yin te/ ①'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la slob slob pa dang /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob slob pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob slob pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la slob slob pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la slob slob pa dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la slob slob pa dang / nang stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang /phyi stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang / dor ba med pa stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la slob slob pa dang / dran pa nye bar 18—593

gzhag pa rnams la slob slob pa dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams la slob slob pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la slob slob pa dang / dbang po rnams la slob slob pa dang / stobs rnams la slob slob pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la slob slob pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la slob slob pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la slob slob pa dang / bsam gtan rnams la slob slob pa dang / tshad myed pa rnams la slob slob pa dang /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la slob slob pa dang / rnam par thar pa rnams la slob slob pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug ①pa rnams la slob slob pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la slob slob pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams la slob slob pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams la slob slob pa dang /gzungs kyi sgo rnams la slob slob pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la slob slob pa dang / myi 'jigs ②pa rnams la slob slob pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la slob slob pa dang / byams pa chen po la slob slob pa dang / snying rje chen po la slob slob pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la slob slob pa dang / thams cad shes pa nyid la slob slob pa dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la slob slob pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la slob slob pa'i zhusangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams dang /rang sangs rgyas rnams dang / dgra bcom pa rnams dang / phyir myi 'ong ba rnams dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams kyis kyang pha rol tu phyin par gyur to/ /pha rol tu phyin to/ /pha rol tu phyin 18—594

par 'gyur ②ro/ /zhes bya bar shes par 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka de bas na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag ②gis de bzhin gshegs pa bzhugs kyang rung / de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das kyang rung ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la brten ①par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad ④kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis ⑤bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te⑨/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis khyabartson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ⑧nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis ⑨bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa nyid la brten ⑩par bya ste7/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 8nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nyan thos 18—595

dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis ①sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ②nyid la brten par bya ste / de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis nang stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka nang stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis phyi stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka phyi stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis phyi nang stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka phyi nang stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar 18—596

gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis chen po stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka chen po stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis don dam pa stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka don dam pa stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis 'dus byas stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka 'dus byas stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la ①brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka thog ma dang tha 18—597

ma myed pa stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis rang bzhin stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka rang bzhin stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis ①chos thams cad stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka chos thams cad stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos ②dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' 18—598

sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka dran pa nye bar gzhag pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis yang dag par spong ba rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka yang dag par spong ba 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma 18—599

yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis ①thu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis ②dbang po rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka dbang po 'di dag ni nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis stobs rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka stobs 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka byang chub kyi yan lag 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la brten par bya stedu/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'di dag ni dunyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la brten par bya steX/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka 'phags 18—600

pa'i bden pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis bsam gtan rnams la brten par bya stekhyo/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka bsam gtan 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis tshad myed pa rnams la brten par bya stedu/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka tshad myed pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la brten par bya ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis rnam par thar pa rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka rnam par thar pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub 18—601

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis ①rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la brten ②par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa 'di dag ②ni/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis mngon par shes pa rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka mngon par shes pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang /rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis ting nge 'dzin rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka ting nge 'dzin 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis gzungs kyi sgo rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka gzungs kyi sgo 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la brten par bya ste④/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub 18—602

sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis myi 'jigs pa rnams la brten par bya ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka myi 'jigs pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la brten par bya stel/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka so so yang dag par rig pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis snying rje chen po la brten par bya stel/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka snying rje chen po 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te / lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la brten par bya ste④/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa 'di dag ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis thams cad shes pa nyid la brten par bya ste'u/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka thams cad shes pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de 18—603

dag gis lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid la brten par bya stel/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ②'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no/ /de dag gis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid la brten par bya ste④/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'di ni nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thams cad kyi rten yin te/ lha dang myi dang lha ma yin gyi skye dgu'i bar gyi rten yin no// //shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyi shu gcig ④pal/ kau shi ka rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i phyir/ rin po che sna bdun gyi mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa byas te/ de la nam 'tsho'i bar du 'ulha rdzas kyi mye tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi chos gos dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan mang pos rim gror byas/ bkur ster byas/ phu dud du byas/mchod par byas na/ kau shi ka de la ji snyam du sems/ de'i phyir ⑥rigs kyi bu'am / rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams mang du 'phel lam/ brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas kyang rigs kyi bu'am 18—604

rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing 'dzin pa dang /'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / gzhan la yang rgya cher ston cing / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems dang myi 'bral la/ gong du me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis ①rim gror byed/ bkur ster byed/ phu dud du byed/ mchod par byed na/bsod nams de ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka mchod rten gcig lta zhog gi/kau shi ka gal te/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas/ mchod pa'i phyir 'dzam bu'i gling 'di rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la rgyar dpag tshad phyed pas yongs su bkang ste/ de dag la nam 'tsho'i ②bar du lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi chos gos dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi ⑤sil snyan mang pos rim gror byas/ bkur ster byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par byas nadu/kau shi ka de la ji snyam du sems/ de'i phyir rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams mang du 'phel lam/ brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas kyang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang 18—605

gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di glegs bam du byas shing 'dzin pa dang /'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa dang / bris shing mye tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang /byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror byed/ bkur ster byed / phu dud du byed/ mchod par byed na/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams byur bu ①de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten gyis yongs su bkang ba lta zhog gi/ kau shi ka gal te rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i phyir/ 'jig rten gyi khams 'bring po stong gnyis pa 'di rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/rgyar ②dpag tshad phyed pas yongs su bkang ste/ de dag la nam 'tsho'i bar du lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang /lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi chos gos dang /lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan mang pos rim gror byasal/bkur stir byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par byas na/ kau shi ka de la ji snyam du sems/ de'i phyir rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams mang du 'phel lam/ brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas kyang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo/ gang shes 18—608

rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di bris shing 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang /klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed cing /mye tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang /① byug pa dang / phye ma dang /na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror byed/ bkur ster byed/ phu dud du byed/mchod par byed na/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka 'jig rten gyi khams 'bring po stong gnyis pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten gyis yongs su bkang ba lta zhog gi/ kau shi ka gal te rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nasal/ mchod pa'i phyir stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pas yongs su bkang ste/ de dag la ②nam 'tsho'i ⑤bar du lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi chos gos dang /lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan mang pos rim gror byas/bkur bstir byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par byas na/ kau shi ka de la meji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams mang du 'phel lam/ brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas kyang rigs ⑤kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 18—609

'di 'dzin par byed/ 'chang bar byed/ klog par byed kun chub par byed tshul bzhin du yid la byed cing / mye tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang /byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror byed/ bkur ster byed / phu ①dud du byed/ mchod par byed na/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /kau shi ka stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams de bzhin gshegs pa'i mchod rten kyis ②yongs su bkang ba lta zhog gi/ kau shi ka stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ sems can ji snyed ①yod pa de dag las sems can re res/ de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod ④pa'i phyir/ rin po che sna bdun las byas pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam laphya/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag byas te/ de dag la nam 'tsho'i bar du lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang /lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi chos gos dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang /lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan mang pos rim gror byas/ bkur stir byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par ⑥byas pa bas/ rigs ⑦kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing bzung ba dang / bcangs pa dudang / blags ⑨pa dang / kun chub par byas pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byas pa dang /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems dang yang ma bral bar byas te/ de la me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang /18—610

na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror byas/ bkur stir byas/ phu dud du byas/mchod par byas na/ de nyid bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo༅ brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de de ②lags so/ /bde bar gshegs pa de de ②lags te/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la rim gror bgyis pa dang / bkur ster bgyis pa dang / phu dud du bgyis pa dang /mchod par bgyis pas ni/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams ④rim gror bgyis pa dang / bkur ster bgyis pa dang / phu dud du bgyis pa dang / mchod par bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res kyang de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas/ mchod pa'i slad du rin po che sna bdun las bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis ste④/de dag la bskal pa'am/ bskal pa'i ④lhag mar ⑦lha rdzas kyi me tog dang /lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang /lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang /lha rdzas kyi ⑧rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan sna tshogs kyis ⑨rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/mchod par bgyis pa dang / lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res 18—611

kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du / rin po che sna bdun las bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la / rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te/ de dag la bskal pa'am/bskal pa'i ②lhag mar ②lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis / bkur ster bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis pa dang / nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du/ rin po che sna bdun las bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam las/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te/ de dag la bskal pa'am/ bskal pa'i ④lhag mar dulha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang /lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/bkur ster bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis pa dang / byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du/ rin po che sna bdun las 18—612

bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te / de dag la ①bskal pa'am/ bskal pa'i ②lhag mar ④lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang /④ lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang /lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi ⑤sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur ster bgyis / phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis pa dang / byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams ⑥kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res kyang de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du/ rin po che sna bdun las bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te/ de dag la ⑦bskal pa'am/ bskal pa'i dulhag mar 0lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang /lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi ⑫ sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur ster bgyis / phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis pa dang / shar lho'i tunyephyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las/ sems can re res kyang de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du/ rin po che sna bdun las bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag 18—613

tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te/ de dag la bskal pa'am/ bskal pa'i ①lhag mar lha lardzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi chasil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/bkur ster bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis pa dang / lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams ④kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res kyang de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du/ rin po che ⑤sna bdun las bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te/ de dag la bskal pa'am/ bskal pa'i ༅lhag mar ⑦lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang /lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang /lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi 3mosil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis / phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis ⑨pa dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res kyang de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du/ rin po che sna bdun las bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te/ de dag la bskal pa'am/ bskal pa'i ⑩lhag mar ⑩lha 18—614

rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang /lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi lasil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis / phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis pa dang / 'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi phye ②ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res kyang de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du/ rin po che sna bdun las byas ③pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te/ de dag la bskal pa'am/ bskal pa'i ④lhag mar ⑧lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang / lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi ⑥sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis pa dang / steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi phye ⑦ma snyed na/ sems can ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag las sems can re res kyang de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das nas mchod pa'i slad du/ rin po che sna bdun las bgyis pa'i mchod rten 'phang du dpag tshad tsam la/ rgyar dpag tshad phyed pa sha stag bgyis te/ de dag la bskal pa'am/ bskal pa'i ⑧lhag mar 0lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / lha rdzas kyi phreng ⑩ba dang / lha rdzas kyi spos dang / lha rdzas kyi byug pa dang / lha 18—615

rdzas kyi phye ma dang / lha rdzas kyi na bza' dang / lha rdzas kyi gdugs dang /lha rdzas kyi rgyal mtshan dang / lha rdzas kyi ba dan dang / lha rdzas kyi lasil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/mchod par bgyis na/ bcom ldan 'das de la ②ji ltar dgongs/ de'i slad du rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag gi ②bsod nams mang du 'phel ba lags sam/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka mang ngo / /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de bas kyang rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing / 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid ④cing /de la me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang /na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur ster bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/mchod par bgyis srin/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ / de ci'i ⑥slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa ⑦'di'i nang du dge ba'i chos thams cad 'dus te/ 'di ltar dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad med pa bzhi dang /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang /phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 18—616

dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams ①dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ②dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /du mtshan ma myed pa ④dang / smon pa myed pa gsum ⑤dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa sdug bsngal ba ⑥dang / kun 'byung ba dang / 'gog ⑦pa dang / lam bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa drug dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs ⑧pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / byams pa chen po dang /snying rje chen po dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad dang / thams cang shes pa nyid dang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang 'dus so/ /de ni sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams kyis ⑨bstan pa ste0 / de la bslabs shing tunye'adas pa dang /18—617

ma byon pa dang / da ltar byung ba'i ②nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas dang /sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das thams cad kyis ②chos thams cad kyi pha rol tu phyin par gyur to/ /phyin to/ /phyin par 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa las / le'u brtswa brgyad do④// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ rigs kyi bu'am / rigs kyi bu mo de dag gi⑤/ bsod nams mang du 'phel lo/ /gang gis ༅shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing / glegs bam du byas te/'dzin cing 'chang ba dang / klog cing kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed cing / gong du me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror byas/bkur ster byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par byas na/ de'i phyir rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag gi ⑦bsod nams ni tshad myed grangs myed/bsam gyis myi khyab/ mtshungs pa myed/ dpag tu myed par 'phel lo de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ nide bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol 18—618

tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ nang stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ phyi stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ phyi nang stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ chen po stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ don dam pa stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dol/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/18—619

dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ yang dag par spong ba rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ dbang po rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ stobs rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ bsam gtan rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ tshad myed pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ rnam par thar pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ mthar kyis ①gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/mngon par shes pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ting nge 'dzin rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/gzungs kyi sgo rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung 18—620

ba ni/ myi 'jigs pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ byams pa chen po'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ snying rje chen po'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i spyan lnga'o①/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ sems can yongs su smin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa'o/ /kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/thams cad shes pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/ /kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ nyan thos kyi theg pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ theg pa chen po'o/ /kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub bo/ /kau shi ka de bas na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris te/ glegs bam du byas shing 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ②ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed cing me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang /sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror byas/ bkur ster byas/ phu dud du byas/18—621

mchod par byas na/ bsod nams mngon par 'du bya ba 'di la bsod nams ①mngon par 'du bya ba snga mas ②brgya'i char yang nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /stong gi cha dang / brgya phrag stong gi cha dang / bye ba'i cha dang / bye ba brgya'i cha dang /bye ba stong gi cha dang / bye ba brgya phrag stong gi cha dang / grangs dang / cha dang / bgrang ba dang / dper yang nye bar myi 'grol/ rgyur yang nye bar myi bzod do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ji srid du/ 'dzam bu'i gling na gnas pa de srid du sangs rgyas dkon mchog nub par myi 'gyur ro/ /chos dkon mchog nub par myi 'gyur ro/ /dge 'dun dkon mchog nub par myi 'gyur ro/ / de srid du dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan bzhi 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /④tshad myed pa bzhi ⑤'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro / /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi ⑥'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa lnga ⑦'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyi stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung 18—622

bar 'gyur ro/ /chen po stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur rol/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang po rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur rol/ /bsam gtan rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 18—623

'jug pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / rnam par thar pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /①rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro//ting nge 'dzin rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /byams pa chen po ②'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /snying rje chen po du'ajig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa ④brgyad 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /thams cad shes pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de srid du rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /khyim bdag gi rigs ①che zhing mtho ba rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sum cu ②rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mtshe ma'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /⑦dga' ldan gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /du'aphrul dga'i 18—624

lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshangs ris kyi ⑦lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshangs chen gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /snang ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chung snang gi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed snang ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ / kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /②dge ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chung dge'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed dge ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /che ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chung che'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed che ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi che ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi gdung ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gya rnam snang ba'i lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'og myin gyi lha rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams dang / phyir myi 'ong ba rnams dang / dgra bcom pa rnams dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams 18—625

dang / yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams ①'byung ba yod do / /bla na myed pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ye shes yod do/ /chos kyi 'khor lo bskor khub yod do/ /sems can yongs su smin pa yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi zhing yongs su dag pa yod do/ /de nas stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams dang / sum cu nirtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang / mtshe ma'i lha rnams dang / dga' ldan gyi ④lha rnams dang / 'phrul dga'i lha rnams dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams dang / tshangs ris kyi ④lha rnams dang / tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams dang / tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams dang / tshangs chen gyi lha rnams dang /snang ba'i lha rnams dang / chung snang gi lha rnams dang / tshad myed snang ba'i lha rnams dang / kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams dang / dge ba'i lha rnams dang /chung dge'i lha rnams dang / tshad myed dge ba'i lha rnams dang / dge rgyas kyi lha rnams dang / che ba'i lha rnams dang / chung che'i yilha rnams dang / tshad myed che ba'i lha rnams dang / 'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams dang / myi che ba'i lha rnams dang / myi gdung ba'i lha rnams dang / shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams dang / gya nom snang ba'i lha rnams dang / 'og myin gyi lha gang ji snyed yod pa de dag la/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis smras pa/ grogs po dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gzung bar bya'o/ /grogs po dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bcang bar bya'o/ /grogs po dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa klag ⑦par bya'o / /grogs nipo dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa kun chub par bya'o/ /18—626

grogs po dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa tshul bzhin du yid la bya'o/ /grogs po dag shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzung ①ba dang / bcangs pa dang / blags ②pa dang / kun chub par byas pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byas pas ni/ sangs rgyas kyi tshul rgyun 'chad ②par myi 'gyur ro/ /chos kyi tshul rgyun 'chad ①par myi 'gyur ro/ /dge 'dun gyi tshul rgyun 'chad ⑤par myi 'gyur ro/ /grogs po dag sangs rgyas kyi tshul ①rgyun ma chad la/ grogs po dag chos kyi tshul rgyun ma chad de/ grogs po dag dge 'dun gyi tshul ༅rgyun ma chad na/ sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyind pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyi stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chen po stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig 18—627

rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro / /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dbang po rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /stobs rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur rol/ /tshad myed pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par thar pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ①'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams 'jig rten du 18—628

'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro//de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /①snying rje chen po 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i spyod pa 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro / /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /rang byang chub 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin la bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka khyod kyis gshes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di zungs shig /chongs shig /lhogs shig /kun chub par gyis shig /kau shi ka khyod kyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di tshul bzhin du yid la gyis shig /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka nam lha ma yin rnams 'di snyam du sems shing / sum cu rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams dang 'thab mo bya'o/ /④sum cu ⑤ma gsum gyi lha rnams dang tsham bsngal yilo snyam na/ de'i tshe kau shi ka khyod kyis ⑩shes rab hūṃ pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yid kyis soms nil kha ton gyis shig /tshul bzhin du yid la gyis shig dang / des lha ma yin gyi bsam ⑨pa de dag phyir nub par 'gyur te⑩ / sems bskyed pa de dag zlos shing ⑪/18—629

rnam par 'phel ①bar mi 'gyur ro/ /lha'i bu dang lha'i bu mo gang dag shi 'pho ba'i tshe/ nam bdag cag ngan song du skye bar mthong na yang / kau shi ka khyod kyis de dag gi mdun du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha ton du gyis shig dang / de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ②thos pa'i dge ba'i rtsa ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la mos pas/ lha'i gnas de nyid du skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di thos pa ni de ltar don dang ldan pa ste/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo ③gang ④su yang rung ste/ gang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di thos par gyur pa ⑤de dag thams cad kyang dge ba'i rtsa ba des/ mthar kyis bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'das pa'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig byung ba de dag thams cad khyakyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la bslabs ⑦nas/ phung po ma lus pa'i mya ngan las 'das pa'i dbyings su yongs su ②mya ngan las 'das so/ /ma byon pa'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig 'byung ba ⑨de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslabs shing ⑩/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /da ⑩ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang 18—630

bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag thams cad kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslabs te①/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i nang du nyan thos kyi chos sam/ rang sangs rgyas kyi chos sam/ byang chub sems dpa'i chos sam/ sangs rgyas kyi chos kyang rung ste/ byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos thams cad 'dus so/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rig sngags chen mo'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni bla na med pa'i rigs ②sngags so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i rig sngags so/ /de ci'i slad du ①zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni myi dge ba'i chos thams cad spong ba'o/ /dge ba'i chos thams cad sgrub pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ kau shi ka 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni rig sngags chen mo'o④/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni bla na myed pa'i rig sngags so/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni myi mnyam pa dang mnyam pa'i rig sngags so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar 'das pa'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ji snyed cig byung ba de dag kyang rig sngags 'di nyid la brten ༷te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon 18—631

par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /ma byon pa'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag kyang rig sngags 'di nyid la brten ①te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /da ltar phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ②ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba de dag kyang rig sngags 'di nyid la brten khyate/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rig sngags 'di yod na/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin / bsam gtan bzhi 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ tshad myed pa bzhi 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ mngon par shes pa lnga 'jig rten na yod pa yin/sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na yod pa yin/bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ phyi stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ phyi nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin / chen po stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ don dam pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid du'ajig rten na yod 18—632

pa yin/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ yang dag par spong ba rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ dbang po rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ stobs rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ ①rnam par thar pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ mthard kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa med pa 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ mngon par shes pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin / ting nge 'dzin rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ myi 'jigs pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ so so 18—633
