yang dag par rig pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ byams pa chen po 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ snying rje chen po 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ chos kyi dbyings 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ yang dag pa'i mtha' 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ de bzhin nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/chos nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ chos kyi gnas nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ chos skyon myed pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ myig lnga 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu 'jig rten na yod pa yin/lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ dgra bcom pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin / rang byang chub 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ thams cad shes pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'jig rten na yod pa yin// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyi shu gnyis ①pa/ kau shi ka byang chub sems dpa' yod na/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ bsam gtan bzhi 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ tshad myed pa bzhi 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ mngon par shes pa lnga 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/18—634

tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ phyi stong pa nyid 'jig rten na ①gdags su yod pa yin / phyi nang stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ chen po stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ don dam pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ yang 18—635

dag par spong ba rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ dbang po rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ stobs rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/'phags pa'i bden pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ ①rnam par ②thar pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ rnam par thar pa'i ②stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ mngon par shes pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/④ ting nge 'dzin rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ myi 'jigs pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ so so yang dag par rig pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/④ snying rje chen po 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ thams cad shes pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ rgyun tu zhugs pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ phyir myi 'ong ba 'jig rten 18—636

na gdags su yod pa yin/ dgra bcom pa 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ rang sangs rgyas 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas 'jig rten na gdags su yod pa yin nonyu/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yod na/ rtsi ②dang rgyu skar dang / skar ma thams cad gdags su yod do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du byang chub sems dpa'i zla ba'i dkyil 'khor yod na/dudage ba'i spyod pa dang / yang dag pa'i spyod pa dang du/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam dang / bsam gtan dang / tshad myed pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / mngon par shes pa dang / pha rold tu phyind pa dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos dang / stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa dang / rnam par thar pa dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dang / ting nge 'dzin dang / gzungs kyi sgo dang / stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa'i rtsi ⑤thams cad gdags su yod do/ /slob pa dang / myi slob pa dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi rgyu skar dang / skar ma thams cad kyang rjogadags su yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang 'jig rten na yod par 'gyur ro/ /gang gi tshe sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams 'jig rten du ma byung ba de'i tshe na yang byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams sems can rnams la 'jig rten pa dang /'jig rten las 'das pa'i ༅chos ston to/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ byang chub 18—637

sems dpa' las byung ba ni nyan thos kyi theg pa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa dang / theg pa chen po rnams te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po thabs mkhas pa gang dang ldan pas/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa ①dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa dang / nang stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / phyi stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / chen po stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid la spyod pa dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams la spyod pa dang / yang dag par spong ba rnams la spyod pa dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams la spyod pa dang / dbang po rnams la spyod pa dang / stobs rnams la spyod pa dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams la spyod pa dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa la spyod pa dang /18—638

'phags pa'i bden pa rnams la spyod pa dang / bsam gtan rnams la spyod pa dang / tshad myed pa rnams la spyod pa dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams la spyod pa dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad la spyod pa dang /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ①la spyod pa dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa la spyod pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams la spyod pa dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams la spyod pa dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams la spyod pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams la spyod pa dang / myi 'jigs ②pa rnams la spyod pa dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams la spyod pa dang / ②snying rje chen po la spyod pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams la spyod pa dang /nyan thos kyi sar myi ltung ba dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa mngon du myi byed pa dang / sems can yongs su spyin par byed pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing ④yongs su dag par byed pa dang / tshe phun sum tshogs pa yongs su 'dzin pa dang /sems can phun sum tshogs pa yongs su 'dzin pa dang / sangs rgyas kyi zhing phun sum tshogs pa yongs su 'dzin pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' phun sum tshogs pa yongs su 'dzin pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ⑤rjes su thob par byed pa'i thabs mkhas pa de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa khyalas byung bar rig par bya'o/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu 'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang /klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de ni tshe 'di'i yon tan 'di dag dang / tshe rabs gzhan kyi yon ⑦tan 'di dag 18—639

dang yang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid ①pa dang /tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid ②pa de tshe 'di'i yon tan gang dang ldan par 'gyur ba lags/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa de/ sngon gyi las kyi rnam par smin pa ma gtogs par dug gis dus byed par myi 'gyur ro/ /mtshon gyis dus byed par myi 'gyur ro/ /myes dus byed par myi 'gyur ro/ /chus dus byed par myi 'gyur ba nas/ nad brgya rtsa gcig gi bar gyis dus byed par myi 'gyur ro/ /rgyal po dang / blon pos ①gnod par bya ba zhig byung ba las/ gal te rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha ton ⑤byed cing / rgyal po'i pho brang du song na/de la glags tshol ⑤ba de dag gis glags myi rnyed de/ rgyal po'i bu dang / rgyal po'i blon po chen po dag kyang gtam dri ba dang / gtam bya bar ⑥sems shing dga' bar bya bar sems par 'gyur 'o⑦/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ ⑧de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid kyi gzi brjid dang / mthus de ltar sems so//gal te rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di kha ton ⑨byed cing / rgyal po'i pho brang du song na/ de la rgyal po'i bu'am/rgyal po'i blon po chen po dag kyang dga' ba'i tshig gis gtam dri ba dang / gtam bya bar sems shing / dga' bar bya bar tho )sems par tunye'agyur ro/ /18—640

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis sems can thams cad la byams pa'i sems nye bar gzhag /snying rje'i sems dang / dga' ba'i sems dang / btang snyoms kyi sems nye bar gzhag pa'i phyir te/ kau shi ka rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang /kun chub par byed pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la byed pa ni/ tshe 'di'i yon tan de dag dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka tshe rabs gzhan gyi yon tan gang dag dang ldan par 'gyur zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ nam yang dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam rnams dang bral ①bar myi 'gyur te/ bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / pha rol tu phyin pa drug dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang /yang dag par spong ba rnams dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams dang / dbang po rnams dang / stobs rnams dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang /lam rnams dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang / bsam gtan rnams dang / tshad myed pa rnams dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa rnams dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams dang /ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams dang / myi 'jigs ②pa rnams dang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang / rgyasangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams dang bral ④bar myi 18—641

'gyur ro/ /de sems can rnams yongs su spyin par bya ba'i smon lam gyi dbang ma gtogs par nam yang sems can dmyal bar myi skye/ byol song gi skye gnas su myi skye/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten du myi skye'o/ /de nam yang yan lag nyams pa can du myi 'gyur/ nam yang dbul po'i rigs su myi skye/ sbyig ma mkhan gyi rigs sam/ sgye sha can gyi rigs sam/ mgar ba'am/ phyag dar ba'am/shen ①pa'am/ phag gsod pa'i rigs sam/ dmangs rigs su myi skye ste/rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad ②par myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu ②rtsa gnyis dang ldan par 'gyur / 'jig rten gyi khams gang na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams de rjodag tu rdzus shing ⑤skye bar 'gyur te/ nam yang byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa dang 'bral dubar myi 'gyur ro/ /de 'dod na sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das rnams la blta ba dang / phyag bya ba dang / bsnyen bkur ba ⑦dang / chos nyan ⑧pa'i phyir/sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro bar 'gyur te⑨/ de sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du 'gro zhing / sems can rnams kyang yongs su sbyin par byed/ sangs rgyas kyi zhing yang yongs su dag par byed do0//kau shi ka de bas na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo yon tan 'di dag phun sum ⑪tshogs par 'dod pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzung bar bya/bcang bar bya/ klag 8par bya/ kun chub par bya/ tshul bzhin du yid la bya/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi sems dang ma bral bar byas te0/ de dag ni nam bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du/ tshe 'di'i yon tan dang / tshe rabs gzhan gyi yon 18—642

tan/ de dag dang ldan par 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa las①/ le'u bcu dgu'o②// //de nas mu stegs can gzhan dang / kun tu rgyu ba/ glags lta duba'i bsam pa can brgya tsam zhig /bcom ldan 'das gang na ba de logs su dong ba dang / de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du sems par gyur te/ mu stegs can gzhan dang / kun tu rgyu ba dubargya po glags lta ⑤ba'i bsam pa can 'di dag /bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der dong nadu/ de la bdag gis ci nas kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa brjod pas/ mu stegs can gzhan dang /kun tu rgyu ba 'di dag bcom ldan 'das kyi drung du dong ⑦nas/ bar chad byed par myi 'gyur bar bdag gis bcom ldan 'das las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las ji nisnyed cig bzung ba de dag kha ton du bya'o snyam nas/ de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las ⑨ji snyed cig bzung tho )ba de dag kha ton du brjod do/ /de nas mu stegs can gzhan dang / kun tu rgyu ba de dag rgyang ring po ring po nas/bcom ldan 'das la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas nas lam de nyid dang / sgo de nyid nas phyir dong ngo / / de nas 0tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu 'di snyam du gyur te/ de ltar mu stegs can gzhan dang / kun tu rgyu ba de dag gis rgyang ring po ring po nas/ bcom ldan 'das la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas te/ lam de nyid dang / sgo de nyid nas phyir dong na de ci'i rgyu ⑩zhig snyam pa dang / de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis tshe dang ldan pa sha ra dwa ti'i bu'i sems 18—643

kyi kun tu rtog pa thugs kyis ①thugs su chud nas/ tshe dang ldan pa sha ra ②da ti'i bu la bka' stsal pa/ sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ni lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang dag par bsams ③pas/ de'i phyir mu stegs can gzhan ④dang / kun tu rgyu ba 'di dag rgyang ring po ring po nas/nga la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba byas te/ lam de nyid dang / sgo de nyid nas phyir dong ba yin no/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu mu stegs can gzhan dang / kun tu rgyu ba 'di dag las 'ga' tsam la yang dkar po'i sems dang ldan pa ma mthong ste/mu stegs can gzhan dang / kun tu rgyu ba 'di dag thams cad ni gnod par bya ba'i sems dang ldan pa glags lta 0ba'i bsam pa can sha stag ste/ 'khor 'dir 'ong bar sems pa sha stag kyang / sha ra dwa ti'i bu ngas ni 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa/ bdud dang dubacas pa/ tshangs par ⑦bcas padu/ dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu'i nang na gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bstan pa'i tshe/ zhe snang ba'i sems sam/ glags lta ⑨ba'i bsam pas nye bar 'gro ba 0 ma mthong ste/ de ni gnas myed do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/sha ra dwa ti'i bu de ni 'di ltar stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di na/ rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha'i bu dang / sum cu yirtsa gsum dang /mtshe ma dang / dga' ldan dang / 'phrul dga' dang / gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i bu dang / tshangs ris dang / tshangs lha nye phan dang /tshangs pa kun 'khor dang / tshangs chen dang / snang ba dang / chung snang dang / tshad myed snang ba dang / kun snang dang 4)ba dang / dge ba dang /chung dge dang / tshad myed dge ba dang / dge rgyas dang / che ba dang /18—644

chung che dang / tshad myed che ba dang /① 'bras bu che ba dang / myi che ba dang / myi gdung ba dang / shin tu mthong ba dang / gya rnam snang ba dang /'og myin gyi lha gang ji snyed cig yod pa dang / nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas gang ②ji snyed cig yod pa dang / byang chub sems dpa' gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa las byung ba sha stag go/ /sha ra dwa ti'i bu gzhan yang shar phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / myi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go/ /lho phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyeng dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang /gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang /myi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir 18—645

zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go/ /nub phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang /dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi'am ci dang /lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go/ /byang phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i ⑨klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go/ /byang shar gyi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i ②klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /18—646

lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go/ /shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go/ /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams ①kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i ②klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go/ /nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i ③klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/18—647

sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig ①bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang /lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de ②dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go/ /'og gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang /lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / myi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go/ /steng gi phyogs kyi 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i ③klung gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das nyan thos kyi dge 'dun dang bcas pa ji snyed cig bzhugs pa dang / rang sangs rgyas dang / byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po dang / lha dang /klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang / nam mkha' lding dang / myi 'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag thams cad kyis kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yongs su bzung ngo / /18—648

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar de dag thams cad ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba sha stag go/ /de nas bdud sdig to ①can 'di snyam du sems par gyur to/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi 'khor bzhi po 'di dag kyang mngon tu gyur/ 'dod pa na ②spyod pa dang / gzugs na ③spyod pa'i lha 'di dag kyang mngon du gyur pa las 'dir ni gdon mi za bar byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu lung ston ①par 'gyur gyis⑤/ de la bdag gis bcom ldan 'das ga la ba der dong 0ste/ bar chad bya'o/ /snyam nas ⑦bdud sdig to can gyis/ dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa mngon par sprul nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der 'gro 'dod par gyur pa dang /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin 'di snyam du sems par ⑧gyur to/ /kye ma bdud sdig to can 'di dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa mngon par sprul cing /bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der 'gro bar 'dod la bdud sdig to can gyi dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi ⑨rnam par bkod pa 'di ni rgyal po bim bi byas ra'i yidapung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa rnam par bkod pas kyang de tsam myi phod/rgyal po sde rab tu 'pham 8byed dang ⑫/ shākya rnams dang / lid tsa byi ⑫rnams kyi dpung gi tshogs yan lag bzhi pa rnam par bkod pas kyang de tsam myi phod de/ bdud sdig to can 'di ni yun ring po nas bcom ldan 'das la yang glags lta zhing / glags tshol8/ sems can yang dag par brtson pa rnams la yang gtse ⑩ba'i bsam pa can yin gyis0/ bdag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yang dag par bsam par bya'o/ /dran pas brjod par bya'o snyam 18—649

nas / lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yang dag par bsams te①/ dran pas gsal bar brjod pa dang / lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis ji lta ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gsal bar brjod pa de lta de ltar bdud sdig to ②can de dag lam de nyid dang / sgo de nyid nas phyir log go/ /de nas 'khor de na rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha'i bu dang / 'og myin gyi lha'i bar du ji snyed cig 'khod ①pa de dag gis lha rdzas kyi me tog dang / na bza' dumang po mngon par sprul nas/ bar snang gi nam mkha' la 'khod bzhin du bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der gtor te/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba der mngon par gtor nas/ tshig 'di skad du brjod do//'dzam bu'i gling gi myi 'di rnams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la yun ring por spyod par gyur cig /'dzam bu'i gling gi myi 'di dag ji srid du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa de srid du ⑤de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang nub par dugi 'gyur la/ dam pa'i chos kyang yun ring du gnas shing / dge 'dun dkon mchog kyang 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur zhe'o/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi myi rnams ji srid du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la spyod pa de srid du stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang / phyogs bcu kun gyi 'jig rten gyi rgyakhams kyi bar gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang nub par myi 'gyur la/ dam pa'i chos kyang yun ring du gnas shing / dge 'dun dkon mchog kyang 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur zhe'o/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi spyod pa khyad par du 'phags pa yang yod 18—650

par 'gyur zhe'o/ /phyogs gang na rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis ①shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing glegs bam du byas te/'chang ba'i phyogs de ni snang ba dang ldan par rig par bya'o/ /phyogs de ni mgon dang bcas shing mun pa dang bral bar rig par bya'o/ /de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis lha'i dbang po brgya byin dang / 'og myin gyi bar gyi ②lha'i bu de dag la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to/ /kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ lha'i bu dag de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ ji srid du 'dzam bu'i gling gi myi rnams shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la spyod pa de srid du de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyang nub par myi 'gyur la/ dam pa'i chos kyang yun ring du gnas shing / dge 'dun dkon mchog kyang 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams dang / phyogs bcu kun gyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi bar gyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyang nub par myi 'gyur la/ dam pa'i chos kyang yun ring du gnas shing /dge 'dun dkon mchog kyang 'jig rten du 'byung bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyi spyod pa khyad par du 'phags pa yang yod par 'gyur ro/ /phyogs gang na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing glegs bam du byas te②/ 'chang ba'i phyogs de ni snang ba dang ldan par ngas shes so/ /phyogs de ni mgon dang bcas shing mun pa dang bral bar ngas shes so/ /de nas lha'i bu de rjodag gis lha rdzas kyi me tog mang po mngon par sprul nas/ bcom ldan 'das gang na ba 18—651

der mngon par gtor te/ 'di skad kyi tshig brjod do/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la la shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid cing /tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de la bdud dam/ bdud kyi ris su gtogs pa'i lha ①glugs tshol ba rnams kyis glags lamyi rnyed do/ /bcom ldan 'das bdag cag gis kyang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de la rtag tu rgyun myi 'chad ③par bsrung ba dang / bskyab pa dang / bskyang ba dubagyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du ⑤zhe na/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di du'adzin cing 'chang ba dang / klog cing kun chub par bgyid pa dang /tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de ni ston pa'am/ ston pa dang mtshungs pa tsam du bdag cag sems so/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ⑦'dzin cing 'chang ba dang /klog cing kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid ⑧pa de dag ni/ dge ba'i rtsa ba dma' ⑨ba dang ldan pa ma lags te/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang / klog cing kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa de dag ni sngon gyi rgyal ba la bgyi ba bgyis par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha ru rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang / klog cing kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid ( )pa de dag ni/ sangs rgyas mang po 18—652

la bsnyen ①bkur bgyis ②par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang / klog cing kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid nipa de dag ni/ dge ba'i bshes gnyen gyis yongs su bzung bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de ci'i slad du zhe na 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid btsal bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa btsal bar bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang gzhan ma lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang gzhan la/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan ma lags te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid de la gnyis su ma mchis te/gnyis su bgyir ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid las byung ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan la rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang gzhan ma yin/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyang gzhan la/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yang gzhan ma yin te/ de ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen 18—653

pa nyid de la gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar skyed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa las①/ le'u nyi shu'o②// //de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun dudaga' bos bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis/ ji ltar shes rab kyi/ pha rold tu phyind pa'i/ mying yongs su brjod pa mdzad pa de ltar/ sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyind pa'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad do//bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying 0yongs su brjod pa mdzad pa de ltar nang stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar phyi stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/de ltar phyi nang stong pa nyide kyi duspying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar chen po stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar thog ma dang tha 18—654

ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad①/ de ltar dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad do②/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying ③yongs su brjod pa mdzad pa de ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar dbang po rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar stobs rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad dobu/ /ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying 0yongs su brjod pa dumadzad pa de ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar bsam gtan rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar tshad myed pa rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa 18—655

ma mdzad/① de ltar gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad do/ /ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying ⑧yongs su brjod pa ③mdzad pa de ltar rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar mngon par shes pa rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi duphying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad do/ /ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying yongs su brjod pa mdzad pa de ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar myi 'jigs pa bzhi'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad/ de ltar snying rje chen po'i mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad / de ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad kyi mying yang yongs su brjod pa ma mdzad do/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun ⑤dga' bo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni 'di lta ste/ pha rol tu phyin pa lnga dang /stong pa nyid thams cad dang / byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu 0rtsa bdun dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu 18—656

dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang /smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa rnams dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang /myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad dag gi thog mar 'gro ba'o/ /kun tu 'dren pa'o/ /kun ①dga' bo de ji snyam du sems/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su ma bsngos pa'i sbyin pa sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin nam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma ②lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ci snyam ③du sems/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su ma bsngos pa'i tshul khrims tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin nam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ji snyam du sems/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su ma bsngos pa'i bzod pa bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin nam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ji snyam du sems/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su ma bsngos pa'i brtson 'grus brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin nam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ji snyam du sems/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su ma bsngos pa'i bsam gtan bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin nam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags so/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ de ji snyam du sems/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid 18—657

du yongs su ma bsngos ①pa'i shes rab shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin nam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das de ni ma lags na②/ bcom ldan 'das rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du ji ltar yongs su bsngos pa'i sbyin pa sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du ji ltar yongs su bsngos pa'i tshul khrims tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du ji ltar yongs su bsngos pa'i bzod pa bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du ji ltar yongs su bsngos pa'i brtson 'grus brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du ji ltar yongs su bsngos pa'i bsam gtan bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du ji ltar yongs su bsngos pa'i shes rab shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa②/ kun dudaga' bo gnyis su myed pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i sbyin pa ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyind pa yin no/ /myi skye ba'i tshul dang / mi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i sbyin pa ni/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /gnyis su myed pa'i tshul gyis/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i tshul khrims ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i tshul khrims ni/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /gnyis su myed pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i bzod pa ni/ bzod pa'i pha 18—658

rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i bzod pa ni/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /gnyis su myed pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i brtson 'grus ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i brtson 'grus ni/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /gnyis su myed pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i bsam gtan ni/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /myi skye ba'i tshul dang /myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i bsam gtan ni/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /gnyis su myed pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i shes rab ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i shes rab ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yin no/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das ji ltar gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i sbyin pa/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ ji ltar gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i tshul khrims/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags/18—659

ji ltar gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul kyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i bzod pa/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ ji ltar gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i brtson 'grus/brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ ji ltar gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i bsam gtan bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags/ ji ltar gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myi skye ba'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid du yongs su bsngos pa'i shes rab shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa lags / bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gzugs gnyis su myed ①pa'i tshul dang / tshor ba gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / 'du shes gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / 'du byed gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rnam par shes pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / myig gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rna ba gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / sna gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / lce gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / lus gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / yid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / gzugs gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / sgra gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / dri gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / ro gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / reg gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / chos gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / myig gi rnam par shes pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rna ba'i 18—660

rnam par shes pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa gnyis ①su skyed pa'i tshul dang / lce'i rnam par shes pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang /lus kyi rnam par shes pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyend kyis tshor ba gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su skyed pa'i tshul dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen gyis tshor ba gnyis su skyed pa'i tshul dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyend kyis tshor ba gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / sa'i khams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang /chu'i khams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / mye'i khams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rlung gi khams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / nam mkha'i khams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams gnyis su med pa'i tshul dang / ma rig pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / 'du byed gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rnam par shes pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / mying dang gzugs gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / skye mched drug gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / reg pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / tshor ba gnyis su myed 18—661

pa'i tshul dang / sred pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / len pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / srid pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / skye ba gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rga shi gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyind pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / nang stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / phyi stong pa nyid gnyis su skyed pa'i tshul dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / chen po stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang /don dam pa stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gnyis su myed pa'i 18—662

tshul dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang /yang dag par spong ba rnams gnyis su skyed pa'i tshul dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / dbang po rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / stobs rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa gnyis su myed pa'i ②tshul dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / bsam gtan rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / tshad myed pa rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams gnyis su skyed pa'i tshul dang / rnam par thar pa rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / mthard kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa sa/nyis su myed pa'i tshul dang /mngon par shes pa rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / ting nge 'dzin rnams gnyis su skyed pa'i tshul dang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / myi 'jigs ②pa bzhi gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / snying rje chen po gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / dgra bcom pa nyid gnyis su skyed pa'i tshul dang / rang 18—663

byang chub gnyis su myed pa'i tshul dang / bla na skyed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub gnyis su myed pa'i tshul gyis sol/ /gsol pa bcom ldan 'das ji ltar gzugs gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar tshor ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar 'du shes gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang /ji ltar 'du byed gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rnam par shes pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myig gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rna ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sna gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lce gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lus gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar yid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar gzugs gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sgra gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar dri gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar ro gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar reg gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar chos gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang /ji ltar myig gi rnam par shes pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rna ba'i rnam par shes pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sna'i rnam par shes pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lce'i rnam par shes pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lus kyi rnam par shes pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar yid kyi rnam par shes pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myig gi 'dus te reg pa gnyis su ma mchis ②pa'i tshul dang /ji ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa gnyis su ma mchis ②pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lce'i 'dus te 18—664

reg pa gnyis su ma mchis ①pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa gnyis su ma mchis ②pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar yid kyi 'dus te reg pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sa'i khams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar chu'i khams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar mye'i khams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang /ji ltar rlung gi khams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar nam mkha'i khams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rnam par shes pa'i khams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar ma rig pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar 'du byed gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rnam par shes pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar mying dang gzugs gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar skye mched drug gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar reg pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar tshor ba gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sred pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar len pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar srid pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar skye ba gnyis su ma mchis 18—665

pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rga shi gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyind pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar nang stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar phyi stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar phyi nang stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang /ji ltar stong pa nyid stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar chen po stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar don dam pa stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar 'dus byas stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rang bzhin stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang /ji ltar myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar ngo bo 18—666

nyid stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar yang dag par spong ba rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar dbang po rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar stobs rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang /ji ltar byang chub kyi yan lag rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar bsam gtan rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar tshad myed pa rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rnam par thar pa brgyad gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar mthard kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma skyed pa dang / smon pa myed pa gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar mngon par shes pa rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar ting nge 'dzin rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar gzungs kyi sgo rnams gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar myi 'jigs pa bzhi gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar snying rje chen po gnyis su ma 18—667

mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar dgra bcom pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang /ji ltar rang byang chub gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul dang / ji ltar bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub gnyis su ma mchis pa'i tshul gyis lags// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyi shu gsum ①pa/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kun dga' bo/②'di ltar gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gzugs dang pha rold tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshor ba ni tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar tshor ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su skyed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /'du shes ni 'du shes kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar 'du shes dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar skyed do/ /'du byed ni 'du byed kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar 'du byed dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /cirnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ②ltar rnam par shes pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de 18—668

gnyis su byar skyed do/ /myig ni myig gis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar myig dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rna ba ni rna bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rna ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /sna ni snas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sna dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lce ni lces stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lce dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lus ni lus kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni 'di ltar lus dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /yid ni yid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar yid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do//gzugs ni gzugs kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gzugs dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /sgra ni sgras stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sgra dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /dri ni dris stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar dri dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /ro ni ros stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar ro dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /reg ni reg gis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar reg dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /chos ni chos kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar chos dang pha 18—669

rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su med de gnyis su byar myed do/ /myig gi rnam par shes pa ni myig gi rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar myig gi ①rnam par shes pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag ②gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes pa ni rna ba'i rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i rnam par shes pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar med do/ /sna'i rnam par shes pa ni sna'i rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni 'di ltar sna'i rnam par shes pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lce'i rnam par shes pa ni lce'i rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lce'i rnam par shes pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lus kyi rnam par shes pa ni lus kyi rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni 'di ltar lus kyi rnam par shes pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /yid kyi rnam par shes pa ni yid kyi rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar yid kyi rnam par shes pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su med de gnyis su byar myed do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa ni myig gi 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / de ni 'di ltar myig gi 'dus te reg pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su med de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar 18wa 670

myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa ni sna'i 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa ni lce'i 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lce'i 'dus te reg pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag ①gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do//lus kyi 'dus te reg pa ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na / de ni 'di ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa ni yid kyi 'dus te reg pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar yid kyi 'dus te reg pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar med do/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar myig gi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni 'di ltar rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sna'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar skyed do/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de 18—671

ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lce'i 'dus te reg pa'i rkyend kyis tshor ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lus kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba ni yid kyi ①'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar yid kyi ②'dus te reg pa'i rkyen kyis tshor ba dang pha rold tu phyind pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /sa'i khams ni sa'i khams kyis stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sa'i khams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /chu'i khams ni chu'i khams kyis stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar chu'i khams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su skyed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /mye'i khams ni mye'i khams kyis stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar mye'i khams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rlung gi khams ni rlung gi khams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rlung gi khams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /nam mkha'i khams ni nam mkha'i khams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar nam mkha'i khams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do / /rnam par shes pa'i khams ni rnam par shes pa'i khams kyis stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa'i khams dang pha rol tu 18—672

phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /ma rig pa ni ma rig pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar ma rig pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su med de gnyis su byar myed do/ /'du byed ni 'du byed kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar 'du byed dang pha rol tu phyin ①pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rnam par shes pa ni rnam par shes pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rnam par shes pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /mying dang gzugs ni mying dang gzugs kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar mying dang gzugs dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /skye mched drug ni skye mched drug gis stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar skye mched drug dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /reg pa ni reg pas stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar reg pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su skyed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshor ba ni tshor bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar tshor ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /sred pa ni srid pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar sred pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /len pa ni len pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni 'di ltar len pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /srid pa ni srid pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar srid pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed 18—673

do / /skye ba ni skye bas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar skye ba dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rga shi ni rga shis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rga shi dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ / ༅sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyind pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni 'di ltar sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang pha rol tu phyind pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rold tu phyind pa ni tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pas stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pas stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang ①pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /zalanang stong pa nyid ni nang 18—674

stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar nang stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /phyi stong pa nyid ni phyi stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar phyi stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid ni phyi nang stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar phyi nang stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /chen po stong pa nyid ni chen po stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar chen po stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /don dam pa stong pa ①nyid ni don dam pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar don dam pa stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid ni 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/② de ni 'di ltar 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar 18—675

mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar skyed do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do / /rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni ngo bo 18—676

nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams ni yang dag par spong ba rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar yang dag par spong ba rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni rdzu 'phrul gyi ①kang pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rdzu 'phrul gyi larkang pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /dbang po rnams ni dbang po rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar dbang po rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /stobs rnams ni stobs rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar stobs rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyis nistong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar byang chub kyi yan lag rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lam ni lam 18—677

gyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lam dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /bsam gtan rnams ni bsam gtan rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar skyed do/ /tshad myed pa rnams ni tshad myed pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar tshad myed pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni gzugs skyed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni 'di ltar gzugs skyed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rnam par thar pa rnams ni rnam par thar pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni 'di ltar mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ni rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pas stong ste/18—678

de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams ni mngon par shes pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar mngon par shes pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su med de gnyis su byar myed do//ting nge 'dzin rnams ni ting nge 'dzin rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni 'di ltar ting nge 'dzin rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su skyed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams ①ni gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar gzungs kyi sgo rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyis stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su med de gnyis su byar med do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams ni myi 'jigs pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar myi 'jigs pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar so so yang dag par rig pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /②snying rje chen po ni snying rje chen pos stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar snying rje chen po dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams 18—679

ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ①kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni 'di ltar sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bus stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bus stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu ni phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bus stong ste/de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid ni dgra bcom pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar dgra bcom pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /rang byang chub ni rang byang chub kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni 'di ltar rang byang chub dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ni bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyis stong ste/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni 'di ltar bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub dang pha rol tu phyin pa 'di dag gnyis 18—680

su skyed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /kun ①dga' bo de lta bas na/ pha rol tu phyin pa lnga po 'di dag gi thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /stong pa nyid thams cad kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu ②rtsa bdun gyi thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /bsam gtan bzhi'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do//tshad med pa bzhi'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do//gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi'i thog mar ②'gro ba ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /mthard kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /gzungs kyi sgo thams cad 0kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /myi 'jigs pa bzhi'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin 18—681

pa nyid do/ /snying rje chen po'i thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /thams cad shes pa nyid kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi thog mar 'gro ba ni/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa nyid do/ /kun ①dga' bo 'di lta ste dper na/ sa chen po la sa bon btab pa/ rgyu rkyen tshogs par gyur nas/ rnam par 'phel bar 'gyur ba yang / sa chen po ni de dag gi gnas te/ sa chen po la brten ②cing sa bon de dag ②skye bar 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin du shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa la brten ④cing pha rold tu phyind pa lnga po 'di dag rnam par 'phel lo/ /nang stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /phyi stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo ji nang stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo / /chen po stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid rnam par 'phel lo ngo bo 18—682
