'dod du zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de la gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar med do/ /kau shi ka gang ①bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnyis su 'dod pa de ②ni/ bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings la gnyis su 'dod du zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bsam gtan gyi ③pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de la gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /kau shi ka gang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnyis su 'dod pa de ni/ bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings la gnyis su 'dod du zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni du'adi ltar brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de la gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar med do/ /kau shi ka gang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnyis su 'dod pa de ni/ bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings la gnyis su 'dod du zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de la gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do/ /kau shi ka gang tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la gnyis su 'dod pa de ni/ bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings la gnyis su 'dod du zad do//de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings de la gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar skyed do/ /kau shi ka gang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la gnyis su 'dod pa de ni/ bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings la gnyis su 'dod du zad do/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gyis myi khyab 18—732

pa'i dbyings de la gnyis su myed de gnyis su byar myed do// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyi shu lnga ①pa/ /de nas lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni/lha dang / myi dang / lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis phyag bgyi bar 'os pa stedu/ de la bslabs ①pas nidu/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs ⑤par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang yirgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gi tshe bdag chos bzang po'i lha'i 'khor du bdag nyid kyi lha'i dbang po'i stan la mchis par gyur pa de'i tshe/ der lha'i bu gang ji snyed ⑦bdag gi rim gro la mchis pa de dag kun kyang bdag la mchod pa ⑧bgyid de/ nam bdag der ma mchis shing stan de la ma mchis pa de'i tshe yang lha'i bu de dag 'khor der mchis shing / lha'i dbang po brgya byin stan 'di la 'dug cing / sum cu khyam gsum gyi lha rnams la chos ston to zhes stan de la g.yas phyogs su bskor ba bgyis shing /phyag 'tshal 0te slar mchi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du gang na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing 'chang ba dang / kha ton tu bgyid cing gzhan la yang rgya cher ston pa der/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/lha dang / klu dang / gnod sbyin dang / dri za dang / lha ma yin dang /nam mkha' lding dang / myi'am ci dang / lto 'phye chen po ⑩ji snyed cig mchis pa de dag kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i 18—733

sangs rgyas rnams ni 'di las byung ngo / /nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas thams cad kyang 'di las byung ngo / /sems can thams cad kyi bde ba'i yo byad thams cad kyang 'di las byung ngo / /zhes shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la phyag bgyis shing gdud ①pa bgyis nas/ slar mchi bar ②'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i ①sku gdung rnams mchod pa mnga' ba yang /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas duyongs su bsgrubs ⑤pa'i slad du mchod pa mnga' duste/ de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ byang chub sems dpa'i spyad pa spyod pa'i tshe/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi gzhir gyur to/ /rgyur gyur to/ /rkyen du gyur to/ /yongs su sgrub ⑦par gyur to/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta bas na/ cha de gnyis dulas bdag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid len to/ /bcom ldan 'das gang gi ṇitshe/ bdag gis ⑩shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di blangs te/ chos kyi khongs su gtogs pa'i yid kyi ⑩kha ton bgyid pa de'i tshe/ 'jigs pa'am/ bag tsha ba'i mtshan ma tsam yang ⑫/yang dag par rjes su myi mthong ngo / /bcom ldan 'das de ci'i slad du zhe na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni mtshan ma ma tunyemachis/ rtags ma mchis/brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni ⑫smos su ma mchis pa'ohunye/ /bcom ldan 'das bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/bcom ldan 'das bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni mtshan ma ma mchis/18—734

rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni ༅smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod ②du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das nang stong pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis /rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das ③nang stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das phyi stong pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchisadu/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das phyi stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das phyi nang stong pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/bcom ldan 'das phyi nang stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma ⑤mchis/ rtags ma mchis/brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das stong pa nyid stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das chen po stong pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma dumachis/rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das chen po stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das don dam pa stong pa 18—735

nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/bcom ldan 'das don dam pa stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o bcom ldan 'das 'dus byas stong pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das 'dus byas stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis / rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis / brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das rang bzhin stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom 18—736

ldan 'das rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o bcom ldan 'das myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o//bcom ldan 'das dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis/rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/brjod ①du ma mchis ②pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das yang dag par spong ba rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das yang dag par spong ba rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o bcom ldan 'das rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das dbang po rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das dbang po rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das stobs rnams ni mtshan ma 18—737

ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod ①du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das stobs rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod ②du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi yan lag rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ni smos su ma mchis pa'o bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis / brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das ②'phags pa'i bden pa rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das bsam gtan rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/bcom ldan 'das bsam gtan rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das tshad myed pa rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das tshad myed pa rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o / /bcom ldan 'das gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o//bcom ldan 'das rnam par thar pa rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis / brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par thar pa rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod 18—738

du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa myed pa ni/ mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das mngon par shes pa rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das mngon ①par shes pa rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das gzungs kyi sgo rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das myi 'jigs pa rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das myi 'jigs pa rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod ②du ma mchis pa ste/bcom ldan 'das so so yang dag par rig pa rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o /bcom ldan 'das snying rje chen po ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/18—739

brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das snying rje chen po ni smos su ma mchis pa'o / /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams ni smos su ma mchis pa'o bcom ldan 'das thams cad shes pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das thams cad shes pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das lam gyi rnam pa ①shes pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis / rtags ma mchis/ brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni mtshan ma ma mchis/ rtags ma mchis/brjod du ma mchis pa ste/ bcom ldan 'das rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid ni smos su ma mchis pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gal te ⑤shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan ma ma ①mchis pa zhig lags te/ mtshan ma ma mchis pa ma lags na ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyisame/ chos thams cad la mtshan ma ma mchis pa dang / rtags ⑤ma mchis pa dang / brjod du ma mchis pa dang / smos su ma mchis par duthugs su chud de/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ sems can rnams la mtshan ma ma mchis pa dang /rtags ma mchis pa dang / brjod du ma mchis pa dang / smos su ma mchis pa'i chos myi bstan ⑦te/ bcom ldan 'das 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa mtshan ma ma mchis②/ rtags ⑨ma mchis0/ brjod du ma mchis0/18—740

smos ①su ma mchis pas ②de'i slad du/ de bzhin gshegs pas chos thams cad mtshan ma ma mchis pa dang / rtags ma mchis pa dang / brjod du ma mchis pa dang / smos su ma mchis par thugs su chud de/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas/ sems can rnams la mtshan ma ma mchis pa dang / rtags ma mchis pa dang / brjod du ma mchis pa dang / smos su ma mchis pa'i chos bstan rgyato/ / zobacom ldan 'das de dubs na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni/ lha dang / myi dang /lha ma yin du bcas pa'i 'jig rten gyis ⑤me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / dub dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis ④rim gro dang /bkur ste dang / phu dud dang / mchod par dubagyi bar 'os pa'o/ /'bris shing me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang /na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / lha'i yi ba dan dang /sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gro dang / bkur ste dang / phu dud dang /mchod par bgyi bar yi'os pa'o/ /bcom ldan phonye'adas gang la la zhig shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang / klog cing kun chub pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid pa dang / de bris shing me tog dang /phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyid/ bkur stir bgyid/ phu dud du bgyid/ mchod par bgyid na/ 4)de ni nam bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu/18—741

mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas kyi bar du des ①sems can dmyal ba'i rgyud kyi dogs pa ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi rgyud kyi dogs pa ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /nyan thos kyi sa dang /rang sangs rgyas kyi sa'i dogs pa ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /de ni de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba dang ②bya 'bral bar 'gyur rol/ /sems can yongs su smin par bgyi ba dang yang myi 'bral bar 'gyur teX/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la me tog dang /phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gro dang / bkur ste dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa ⑤bgyid cing /sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mchi bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang gal te stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung gis dubyur bur bltam ⑦pa zhig kyang stsal ladu/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yang bris 0te stsal na/ bcom ldan 'das dkon mchog de gnyis las/ bdag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid len to/ /bcom ldan 'das de ci'i slad du zhe na(nye/ 'di las byung ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung rnams te/de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang rim gror bgyi ba dang /bkur ster bgyi ba dang / phu dud du bgyi zhing mchod par bgyi ba yilags te⑩/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dag gis de dag la rim gror bgyis/ bkur ster bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par bgyis na log par ltung ba dang /18—742

ngan song du mchi ①bar myi 'gyur te/ lha dang myi'i phun sum tshogs pa myong nas/smon lam gyi tshul bzhin du nyan thos kyi theg pa 'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa 'am/ yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi theg pas yongs su mya ngan las 'da' bar 'gyur tshoro/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta bas na gang de bzhin gshegs pa mthong ba dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa bris pa mthong ba de ni myi 'dra ba ma mchis so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / de bzhin gshegs pa ②gnyis su ma mchis te②/ gnyis su bgyir ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang gang de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi ducho 'phrul rnam pa gsum la bzhugs te/ mdo dang dbyangs kyis bsnyad ⑤pa dang /lung bstan 0pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang /gleng gzhi rgyadang / 'di ltar 'das pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos rmad du byung ba dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang /chos gtan la bab ⑧pa bstan pa gsungs te bshad pa dang / rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo la las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bzung zhing kun chub par bgyis te/ gzhan la bstan ⑨pa de gnyis hunye kyang myi 'dra ba ma mchis so/ /bcom ldan phospre'adas de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di las byung ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams so 'di las byung ba ni cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum mo/ /'di las byung ba ni mdo dang dbyangs kyis bsnyad 8pa dang / lung bstan 0pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi ④dang / 'di ltar 'das pa dang /18—743

skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos rmad du byung ba dang /rtogs pa brjod pa dang / chos gtan ①la bab ②pa bstan ③pa'o/ /70bcom ldan ⑤'das gzhan yang shar phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / lho phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / nub phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / byang phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / byang shar kyi phyogs mtshams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / shar lho'i phyogs mtshams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang /lho nub kyi phyogs mtshams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / nub byang gi phyogs mtshams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang / 'og gi phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas dang /steng gi phyogs kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gaṅgā'i duklung gi bye ma snyed mang pos cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum la bzhugs te/ mdo dang dbyangs kyis bsnyad ⑦pa dang / lung bstan ⑧pa dang /tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang / gleng gzhi ⑨dang / 'di ltar 'das pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos rmad du byung ba dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang / chos gtan la bab ⑩pa bstan pa gsungs 7te/ bshad pa dang / rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la 18—744

las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzung zhing / kun ②chub par bgyis te/gzhan la ②bstan pa de gnyis kyang myi 'dra ba ma mchis so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na / 'di las byung ba ni phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni cho 'phrul rnam pa gsum mo/ /'di las byung ba ni mdo dang dbyangs kyis bsnyad ①pa dang /lung bstan 0pa dang / tshigs su bcad pa dang / ched du brjod pa dang /gleng gzhi ⑤dang / 'di ltar 'das pa dang / skyes pa'i rabs dang / shin tu rgyas pa dang / chos rmad duXbyung ba dang / rtogs pa brjod pa dang /chos gtan ⑦la bab ⑧pa bstan ⑨pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i phyogs re re zhing gaṅgā'i 0klung gi bye ma snyed kyi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par tunyerdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang /na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis 8rim gro dang / bkur ste dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa bgyis 8pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa 'di glegs bam du bris shing / me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang /sil snyan sna tshogs kyis 8rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang /mchod pa bgyis pa 4)yang myi 'dra ba ma mchis so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/'di las byung ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams so/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi 18—745

bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin cing ①'chang ba dang /klog cing kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid cing /gzhan khyal yang rgya cher ston pa des ni/ sems can dmyal ba'i rgyud kyi dogs pa ma mchis par ①bgyi'o/ /byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi rgyud kyi dogs pa ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /nyan thos kyi sa dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi sa'i dogs pa ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/'di ltar rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo/ de ni phyir myi ldog ④pa'i sa la gnas par rig par bgyi'o/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di ltar de ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing 'dzin to/ /'chang ngo / /klog go/ /kun chub par bgyid do⑤/ /tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid do/ /0bris pa de la yang me tog dang / phreng ba dang /༅ spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang /na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyid/ bkur stir bgyid/ phu dud du bgyid/mchod par bgyidadu/ bcom ldan 'das de ltar na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni 'jigs ⑨pa thams cad zhi bar bgyid pa'o⑩/ /nad thams cad rab tu sel ba'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing 'dzin pa dang / 'chang ba dang / klog pa dang / kun chub par bgyid pa dang / de la me tog dang /phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod par bgyid pa des ni/18—746

gang nas kyang 'jigs pa 'byung ba'i dogs pa ma mchis par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste dper na/ skyes bu nor gyi bdag po zhig 'jigs nas rgyal po la gnas shing / rgyal po la rten ①na/ de rgyal po la gnas shing /rgyal po la rten ②pas/ sus 'jigs pa de dag nyid kyang de la rten ①pas/de dag gis 'jigs par myi 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das de ni 'di ④ltar gsha' te⑤/ gang rgyal po la rten ⑥pa ni mthu dang ldan pa la rten ⑦pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung nide dag kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pas yongs su bsgrubs pas yin/ mchod pa tunye mnga'o/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes gang lags pa de yang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas yongs su bsgrubs 0par blta'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de 8bas na/ bdag gis cha de gnyis las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid blang bar bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de ci'i slad du zhe na/ 'di las byung ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung rnams so/ /'di las byung ba ni myi chen po'i mtshan sum cu 8rtsa gnyis so//'di las byung ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa rnams kyi de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'o / /'di las byung ba ni myi 'jigs pa bzhi'o/ /'di las byung ba ni so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'o④/ /'di las byung ba ni sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad do/ /'di las byung ba ni byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di las byung ba ni pha rol tu phyin pa lnga ste/de dag pha rol tu phyin pa'i mying 'thob bo/ /'di las byung ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi bar du ste/ bcom ldan 18—747

'das grong ngam/ gong rdal lam/ grong khyer ram/ khams sam/ rgyal po'i gnas sam/ stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams gang na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di 'dzin cing 'chang ba dang ①/ klog cing kun chub par bgyid pa dang / de bris shing rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa bgyis ⑤pa de dag tu myi'am myi ma lags pa glags lta ②zhing glags tshol ba rnams kyis/ glags rnyed par myi 'gyur te/ sems can de dag thams cad kyang theg pa gsum las theg pa gang yang rung bas/ mthar kyis yongs su mya ngan las 'da' ba'i chos can du 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de lta bas na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni don chen po dang ldan pa ste / stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams na/ de ltar sems can rnams kyi sangs rgyas kyi don du nye bar gnas so/ /bcom ldan 'das 'jig rten gyi khams gang na shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di mchis ④pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams der ni/ sangs rgyas byung ⑤ba dang 'dra bar blta'o/ /bcom ldan 'das 'di lta ste dper na/ nor bu rin po che chen po myi dpogs ⑥rin chen ces ⑦bgyi ba mchis te/ de ni nor bu rin po che chen po'i yon tan durnam pa 'di lta bu dag dang ldan te/ nor bu rin po che chen po de gang dang gang du bzhag pa de dang ⑨der myi ma lags pa rnams kyis glags myi rnyed do/ /myi ma lags pas zin pa'i skyes pa'am bud myed kyang nor bu rin po che de bstan ⑩na / myi ma lags pa de nor bu rin po che chen po de'i gzi ⑩brjid myi bzod de8/myur du 'pho zhing myi gnas so/ /mkhris pas gdungs pa'i tsolus la nor bu rin po che chen po de btags na/ mkhris ④pa de yang 'byang 8bar 'gyur ro/ /18—748

rlung gis mnar ba'i lus la/ nor bu rin po che chen po de ①btags na/rlung de yang 'byang ②bar 'gyur ro/ /bad kun gyis non pa'i lus la nor bu rin po che chen po de btags na/ bad kun de yang zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /'dus pa'i bros btab pa'i lus la/ nor bu rin po che chen po dude btags na/'dus pa'i bro de yang zhi bar 'gyur zhing rnam par myi 'phel lo/ /nub mo ni snang bar bgyid do④/ /tsha ba'i dus na ni nor bu rin po che chen po de phyogs gang du bzhag pa'i ༅phyogs de bsil bar bgyid do/ /grang 'uba'i dus na ni nor bu ⑨rin po che chen po nide phyogs gang du bzhag ⑨pa'i ⑨ phyogs de dro bar bgyid do/ /nor bu rin po che chen po de dog sa'i phyogs gang du bzhag pa'i ⑪phyogs de yang ha cang yang myi dro/ ha cang yang myi grang zhing / ran pa phun sum tshogs par bgyid do/ /nor bu rin po che chen po de hunyedog sa'i phyogs gang du bzhag pa'i dog sa'i 8phyogs der sbrul lam de ma lags pa'i ④sdig pa la stsogs ④pa gdug pa gzhan dag kyang rgyu bar myi 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das skyes pa'am/ bud myed la la zhig sbrul gdug 7pas zin pa la/ nor bu rin po che chen po de bstan tshun/ des de mthong ma thag tu dug de yang 'byang 8bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das nor bu rin po che chen po de ni/ yon tan gyi rnam pa 'di lta bu dag dang ldan te/ skyes pa'am/ bud med la la zhig 'brum bus btab bam/ myig rab rib can du gyur 7te/ myig gi du nad dmadu/rna ba'i nad dam/ sna'i nad dam/ lce'i nad dam/ lkog ma'i nad dam/lus kyi nad ci 'byung ba las de'i lus la nor bu rin po tsoche chen po de btags ④na / de dag gi 'brum bu'am/ rab rib bamadu/ myig gi nad dam/ rna 18—749

ba'i nad dam/ sna'i nad dam/ lce'i nad dam/ lkog ma'i nad dam/lus kyi nad de ①dag kyang ②zhi bar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das nor bu rin po che chen po ①de ni yon tan gyi rnam pa 'di lta bu dag dang yang ldan te/ gal te nor bu rin po che chen po de/ chab rtogs 0pa can gyi nang du stsal na/de'i mod la chab de thams cad kyang yan lag brgyad dang ldan zhing kha dog gcig ⑤par 'gyur ro/ /gal te nor bu rin po che chen po de gos sngon pos dkris te/chab kyi nang du stsal na/ chab de yang de'i rang bzhin nyid 0du 'gyur ro/ /gal te nor bu rin po che chen po de gos ser pos dkris ⑦te/ chab kyi nang du stsal na/ chab de yang de'i rang bzhin nyid du 'gyur ro/ /gal te nor bu rin po che chen po de gos dmar pos dkris ②te/ chab kyi spunang du stsal na/chab de yang de'i rang bzhin nyid du 'gyur ro/ / gal te ⑩rnar bu rin po che chen po de/ gos dkar pos dkris 0te/ chab kyi nang du stsal na/ chab de yang de'i rang bzhin nyid du 'gyur ro/ /gal te nor bu rin po che chen po de gos leb rgan gyis 8dkris te/ chab kyi nang du stsal na/ chab de yang 8de'i rang bzhin nyid du 'gyur ro/ /gal te nor bu rin po che chen po de/ shel gyi ⑫kha dog gi tsogos kyis dkris 0te/ chab kyi ⑩nang du stsal na/ chab de yang de'i rang bzhin nyid du 'gyur ro/ /de dag dang gos gzhan rnam pa sna tshogs kyis / nor bu rin po che chen po de dkris 0te/ chab kyi nang yidu stsal na/chab de yang de'i rang bzhin nyid zhu du 'gyur ro/ /chab de la rtogs ⑥pa mchis pa yang nor bu rin po che chen po des 'dang ⑤ste/ bcom ldan 'das nor bu rin po che chen po de ni/ yon tan gyi rnam pa de lta bu dag dang / gzhan yang 18—750

rnam pa mang po dag dang ldan no/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di yang lha rdzas kyi ①rnar bu rin po che chen po de dang 'dra bar yon tan thams cad kyi ②'byung gnas su gyur pa ste/ sdig pa thams cad sel ba'o/ /de nas tshe dang ldan pa kun ②dga' bos/ lha'i dbang po brgya ⑤byin la 'di skad ces smras so/ /kau shi ka de ji snyam ⑤du sems/ nor bu rin po che chen po de lha rdzas shig ⑥yin nam/ 'on tam nor bu rin po che chen po de 'dzam bu'i gling gi myi rnams la yang yod/ /brgya byin gyis smras pa/ btsun pa kun ⑦dga' bo/ /nor bu rin po che chen po de ni lha rdzas te/ btsun pa kun ⑧dga' bo/ /'dzam bu'i gling gi mi rnams la/ nor bu rin po che gang yod pa de dag ni chung zhing lci/ lha rdzas kyi ⑨rnar bu rin po che chen po de dag ⑩ni che zhing yang ste/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi 7phyi rnams kyi nor bu rin po che de dag ni lha rdzas ltar yan lag de dag gis yongs su rdzogs pa ma yin te/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi nor bu rin po che de dag gis ni/ lha rdzas kyi nor bu rin po che'i grangs samatshu/cha'am / bgrang ba'am/ dpe tso'am/ rgyur yang ④nye bar myi 'gro'o/ /de nas yang 8lha'i dbang po brgya byin gyis/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to/ /bcom ldan 'das nor bu rin po che chen po de snod la la zhig gi nang du stsal stsal pa las/ snod de nas phyung yang snod de ni nor bu rin po che de'i yon tan gyis yid du mchis par ⑩'gyur te/ gzhan yang snod de la mos pa bskyed ⑩do/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin du shes tsorab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ⑩'di gang na mchis pa de'i rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de du dag gi 0lus sam/sems kyi sdug bsngal phyedang / gnod pa myi las gyur pa'am/ myi ma lags pa ⑦18—751

las gyur pa thams cad kyang ma mchis par 'gyur ①te/ bcom ldan 'das nor bu rin po che chen po zhes bgyi ba ②ni/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i tshig bla dgas duso/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes kyi tshig bla dgas duso/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan lta ci ⑤skyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan lta ci khyasnyed cig brjod par bgyi ④ste/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan lta ༅ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan lta ⑨ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin 18—752

pa'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das nang stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ nang stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang nang stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das phyi stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ phyi stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang phyi stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang phyi nang stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das chen po stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ①ste/ chen po stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang chen po stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ci asnyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ 'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang 18—753

'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom/ ldan 'das dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ①ste/ rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ rang gi mtshan 18—754

nyid stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das dngos po myed pa ②stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / dngos po myed ②pa stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das yang dag par spong ba bzhi'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / yang dag par spong ba rnams kyi 18—755

snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so//de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das dbang po lnga'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ dbang po rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / dbang po rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das stobs lnga'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ stobs rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / stobs rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / byang chub kyi yan lag rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i ①yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / 'phags pa'i bden pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das bsam gtan bzhi'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ bsam gtan rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / bsam 18—756

gtan rnams kyi ①snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das tshad myed pa bzhi'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ tshad myed pa rnams kyi ②yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / tshad myed pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das gzugs ༅phyed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi snod do / /bcom ldan 'das rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ rnam par thar pa byarnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so//de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / rnam par thar pa rnams kyi snod do / /bcom ldan 'das mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /5de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / mthar gyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ rnam par thar pa'i sgo rnams ⑥kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo ⑦rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das mngon par shes pa rnams kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ ma/ngon par shes pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / mngon par shes 18—757

pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi ①yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / ting nge 'dzin rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung ④de dag kyang / gzungs kyi sgo rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das myi 'jigs pa bzhi'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang /myi 'jigs pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ so so yang dag par rig ①pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / so so yang dag par rig pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das snying rje chen po'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ snying rje chen po'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / snying rje chen po'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin 18—758

gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das thams cad shes pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ thams cad shes pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / thams cad shes pa nyid kyi snod dol/ /bcom ldan 'das lam gyi rnam pa ①shes pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji ②skyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ lam gyi ①rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ de bzhin nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / de bzhin nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das ma nor ba de bzhin nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ ma nor ba de bzhin nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / ma nor ba de bzhin nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang /gzhan ma yin pa de bzhin nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das chos nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ chos nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis 18—759

so / /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / chos nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi dbyings kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/chos kyi dbyings kyi ①yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / chos kyi dbyings kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das chos kyi gnas nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ chos kyi gnas nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang /chos kyi gnas nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das chos myi 'gyur ba nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ chos myi 'gyur ba nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / chos myi 'gyur ba nyid kyi snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das yang dag pa'i mtha'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ yang dag pa'i mtha'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang yang dag pa'i mtha'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / bsam gyis myi khyab pa'i dbyings kyi khyasnod do/ /bcom ldan 'das bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pa'i yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pa'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs ②pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / bag chags kyi mtshams sbyor ba'i nyon mongs pa thams cad spangs pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das rtag tu btang snyoms la gnas pa'i 18—760

yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ rtag tu btang snyoms la gnas pa'i yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / rtag tu ①btang snyoms la gnas pa'i snod do/ /bcom ldan 'das myi nyams ②pa'i chos nyid kyi yon tan lta ji snyed cig brjod par bgyi ste/ myi nyams ②pa'i chos nyid kyi yon tan ni tshad ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag kyang / myi nyams ④pa'i chos nyid kyi snod do/ /de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni mchod pa mnga' 'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni pha rold tu phyind pa phyarin po che'i snod de⑥/ de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni mchod pa mnga'o / /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa ⑦kun nas nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa dang / rnam par byang ba ma mchis pa'i snod de'u/ de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni mchod pa mnga'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni / pha rol tu phyin pa myi skye phyomopyi 'gag pa'i snod deskye/ de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni mchod pa mnga'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa blang ba ma mchis pa dang /dor ba ma mchis pa'i snod de'u/ de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni mchod pa mnga'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni pha rold tu phyind pa dbri ba dang / bsnan pa ma mchis pa'i snod de/de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni mchod pa mnga'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa 'ong ba 18—761

dang / 'gro ba dang / gnas pa ma mchis pa'i snod de/ de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni mchod pa mnga'o/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni pha rol tu phyin pa ①chos nyid kyi snod de②/de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni/ pha rol tu phyin pa ②chos nyid kyis ④yongs su bsgos ⑤pa'o/ /de bas na de bzhin gshegs pa mya ngan las 'das kyang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni mchod pa mnga'o/ /gzhan yang stong gsum gyi ⑤stong chen po'i 'jig rten gyi khams 'di ⑦de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung gis gyur bur yongs su bltam nipa lta zhog gi/ bcom ldan 'das gal te phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i ⑨klung gi bye ma snyed cig /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung gis byur bur bltam ⑩pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa glegs bam du bris pa zhig stsal na0/ bcom ldan 'das rnam pa de gnyis las bdag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid len to/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/ bcom ldan 'das 'di las byung ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyi sku gdung rnams te mchod pa mnga'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ⑫yongs su bsgos 8pas na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung de dag ni ④mchod pa mnga' ste/ bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung rnams la rim gror bgyid pa dang / bkur ster bgyid pa dang / phu dud du bgyid pa dang / mchod par bgyid pa yang dge ba'i rtsa ba de'i mtha' myi dmigs shing / rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba'am/bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba'am/ khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba'am/18—762

rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha'am/ sum cu ①ma gsum gyi lha'am/ mtshe ma'i lha'am / dga' ldan gyi lha'am/ 'phrul dga'i ②lha'am/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha'i nang du myi chadang lha'i phun sum tshogs pa dang / bde ba myong nas dge ba'i rtsa ba de nyid kyis sdug bsngal kyi ④mthar 'byung ste/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung mchod pa'i 'bras bu ni de tsam du bas gyisaX/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bzung zhing bcangs pa ⑥dang / blags ④shing kun chub par bgyid pa dang / tshul bzhin du yid la bgyid ⑧na/ ting nge 'dzin gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /phyi stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /chen po stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur rol/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /18—763

rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /yang dag par spong ba bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /dbang po lnga yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro / /stobs lnga yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub kyi yan lag bdun yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /bsam gtan bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /tshad myed pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /mngon par shes pa rnams yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /myi 'jigs pa ①bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /snying rje chen po yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro//18—764

sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa ①brgyad yongs su rdzogs par 'gyur ro/ /de ched du bsams te ①lus yongs su 'dzin par 'gyur ro/ /lus de dag gis ②sems can yongs su smin par bgyid par 'gyur te/ 'khor los sgyur ④ba'i lus sam/ rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba'am/ bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba'am / khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho bar ⑤skyes pa'i ༅lus sam/ brgya byin gyi gzugs sam/ tshangs pa'i gzugs sam/ ngal bso po'i ④gzugs kyang rung ste/ lus de dag gis sems can yongs su smin par bgyid par 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi sa dang rang sangs rgyas kyi sa las 'das te/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs nas/ byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa 'thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa'i mngon par shes pa thob nas/sangs rgyas kyi zhing nas sangs rgyas kyi zhing du mchi dubar 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das de bas na bdag ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung la rim gro ma mchis pa yang ma lags/ glo ba ma ches pa yang ma mchis/ mchod par myi 'tshal ba yang ma lags/ gzung khyabar myi 'tshal ba yang ma lags te/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ni/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi ⑫bu mo rnams kyis0/ rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang /mchod pa bgyis ④na/ sangs rgyas kyi chos thams cad kyi rgyu shin tu bstsags ⑫pa lags/ phun sum tshogs pa thams cad kyang yongs su zin par 'gyur ro④/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung rnams la yang / rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu 'dud dang / mchod par bgyis ⑩par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 18—765

'das gzhan yang phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi ①khams tshad dang grangs ma mchis pa dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas ji snyed cig bzhugs ②shing 'tsho sriskyong ba dang / chos ston pa de dag ④chos kyi sku dang / gzugs kyi 0sku dang / ye shes kyi skur nyamathong bar 'tshal zhing / mchod par ⑦'tshal bas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid gzung dubar bgyi/ bcang bar bgyi/ klag ⑨par bgyi/ kun chub par bgyi/ mchod par bgyi/ gzhan la rgya cher yang dag par bstan ⑩par bgyi / tshul bzhin du 7yid la bgyi ④ste/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo des ni/ phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams grangs dang / tshad ma mchis pa'i de bzhin gshegs 8pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams mthong bar 'gyur ro/ /de bas na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod pa hu)des/ chos nyid du sangs rgyas rjes su dran pa bsgom par bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag mthong bar 'tshal bas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di gzung 8bar bgyi/ bcang bar bgyi/ klag ⑩par bgyi/ kun chub par bgyi/mchod par bgyi/ gzhan dag tu)la rgya cher yang dag par bstan par bgyi/chos nyid tshul bzhin du 8yang yid la bgyi'o⑩/ /bcom ldan 'das gnyis po 'di dag ni chos ⑥ nyid de0/ gnyis gang zhe na/ 'dus byas 'chos rnams kyi chos nyid dang / 'dus ma byas chos ⑤rnams kyi chos nyid do/ /bcom ldan 'das de la 'dus byas ④chos rnams kyis ④chos nyid gang lags she na/ nang 18—766

stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / phyi stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / phyi nang stong pa nyirdo kyi ye shes dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / chen po stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang /'dus byas stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang /rang bzhin stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid kyi ye shes dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi'i ye shes dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi'i ye shes dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi'i ye shes dang /dbang po lnga'i ye shes dang / stobs lnga'i ye shes dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun gyi ye shes dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa'i ye shes dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi'i ye shes dang / bsam gtan bzhi'i ye shes dang / tshad myed pa bzhi'i ye shes dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi'i ye shes dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad kyi ye shes dang /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu'i ye shes dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa'i ye shes dang / mngon par shes pa lnga'i ye shes dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad kyi ye shes dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad kyi ye shes dang / de bzhin gshegs 3 18—767

pa'i stobs bcu'i ye shes dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi'i ye shes dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi'i ye shes dang / snying rje chen po'i ye shes dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o ①brgyad kyi ye shes dang / dge ba'i chos rnams kyi ye shes dang / myi dge ba'i chos rnams kyi ye shes dang / zag pa myed pa'i chos rnams kyi ②ye shes dang / zag pa dang ④bcas pa'i chos rnams kyi ye shes dang / 'jig rten gyi chos rnams kyi ye shes dang / 'jig rten las 'das pa'i chos rnams kyi ye shes gang lags pa de ni/ 'dus byas kyi ④chos rnams kyi chos nyid ces bgyi'o/ /de la 'dus ma byas kyi chos ⑤rnams kyi chos nyid gang lags she na/ de ni gang la skye ba ma mchis pa dang / 'gag pa ma mchis pa dang / gnas pa ma mchis pa dang / gnas pa las gzhan du 'gyur ba ma mchis pa dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa ma mchis pa dang /rnam par byang ba ma mchis pa dang / 'phel ba ma mchis pa dang / 'grib pa ma mchis pa ste/ de ni chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid do/ /chos thams cad kyi ngo bo nyid gang lags she na/ chos thams cad ni dngos po ma mchis pa'i ngo bo nyid de/ 'di ༅ni 'dus ma byas ༅chos rnams kyi chos nyid ces bgyi'o/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ 'das pa'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag ⑧par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig byung ba de dag kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la brten te/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji 18—768

snyed cig 'byung ①ba de dag kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la brten ②cing / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o②/ /da ltar byung ba'i phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad myed grangs ༷myed pa dag na/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig bzhugs shing 'tsho skyong ba dang /chos ston pa de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la brten ⑤te/bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /'das pa'i dus kyi ⑥de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos gang ji snyed cig byung ba dang /ma byon pa'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos gang ji snyed cig 'byung thob dang / da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyi nyan thos gang ji snyed cig yod pa de dag gis kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa du'adi nyid la brten te/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob bo/ /'thob bo/ /thob par ⑨'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob po//'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid thob po/ /'thob bo /thob par 'gyur ro/ /'das pa'i dus kyi rang sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig byung ba dang / ma 'ongs pa'i dus kyi rang sangs rgyas gang ji snyed cig 'byung ba dang /da ltar byung ba'i 'jig rten gyi khams tshad myed grangs myed pa dag na/ rang sangs rgyas gang ⑩ji snyed cig 'khod cing 'tsho skyong ba de dag gis kyang / shes 18—769

rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la brten te/ rang byang chub thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las theg pa gsum po thams cad rgya cher bstan te/de dag kyang mtshan ma ②skyed pa'i tshul dang / dmyigs pa myed pa'i tshul dang /skye ba myed pa'i tshul dang / 'gag pa myed pa'i tshul dang / kun nas nyon mongs pa myed pa'i tshul dang / rnam par byang ba myed pa'i tshul dang / mngon par 'du bya ba myed pa'i tshul dang / len pa myed pa'i tshul dang / 'dor ②ba myed pa'i tshul dang / dbri ba myed pa'i tshul dang / bsnan pa myed pa'i tshul dang / blang ba myed pa'i tshul dang / spang dub myed pa'i tshul gyis bstan te/de yang 'jig rten gyi tha snyad ④kyi tshul gyis bstan ⑤gyi/ don dam par ni ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni ring du song ba ma yin/ pha rol tu phyin pa ma yin te/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni tshul 4rol ma yin/ pha rol ma yin/ thang du 'dug pa ma yin/ gshong du 'dug pa ma yin/ mnyam pa ma yin/ myi mnyam pa ma yin/ mtshan ma ma yin / mtshan ma myed pa ma yin/ 'jig rten pa ⑦ma yin/ 'jig rten las 'das pa ma yin/ 'dus byas ma yin/ 'dus ma byas phyam yin/ dge ba ma yin/ myi dge ba ma yin/ 'das pa ma yin/ ma 'ongs pa ma yin/da ltar byung ba ma yin te/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams nye bar sgrub pa ma yin/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni rgyun tu zhugs pa'i chos rnams nye bar sgrub pa ma yin/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i chos rnams nye bar 18—770

sgrub pa ma yin/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ phyir myi 'ong ba'i chos rnams nye bar sgrub pa ma yin/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ dgra bcom pa'i chos rnams nye bar sgrub pa ma yin/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ rang sangs rgyas kyi chos rnams nye bar sgrub pa ma yin/ so so'i skye bo'i chos rnams 'dor ba ma yin no// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyi shu drug ①pa / brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ②ni pha rol tu phyin pa chen po ste/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la spyod pa rnams ni sems can thams cad kyi sems dang / spyod pa yang 'tshal te/sems can du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sems can du gdags par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /bdag tu dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sems can du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /srog tu dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /'gro bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /gso ②bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /skyes bur dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /gang zag tu dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /shed can du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /shed bdag tu dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /byed pa por dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /tshor ba por dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /shes pa por dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /mthong ba por dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /gzugs su dmyigs pa ④ma mchis so/ /tshor bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /'du shes su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /'du byed du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rnam par shes par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /myig du dmyigs pa ma mchis so /18—771

rna bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /snar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rtser dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lus su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /yid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /gzugs su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sgrar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /drir dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /ror dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /reg tu dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /chos su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /myig gi rnam par shes par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rna ba'i rnam par shes par dmigs pa ma mchis so/ /sna'i rnam par shes par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lce'i rnam par shes par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lus kyi rnam par shes par ①dmyigs pa ma mchis sokhya/ /yid kyi rnam par shes par dmyigs pa ma mchis so//myig gi 'dus te reg par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rna ba'i 'dus te reg par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor bar dmigs pa ma mchis so/ /sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /yid kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sa'i khams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /chu'i khams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /mye'i khams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rlung gi khams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /18—772

nam mkha'i khams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rnam par shes pa'i khams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /ma rig ①par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /'du byed du dmyigs nga ma mchis so/ /rnam par shes par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /mying dang gzugs su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /skye mched drug tu dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /reg par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /tshor bar dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /srid par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /len par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /srid par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /skye bar dmyigs pa ma mchis sol/ /rga shir dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin par dmyigs pa ma mchis so /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /nang stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /phyi stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so//stong pa nyid stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /chen po stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so /'dus byas stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma 18—773

mchos so/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du ①dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so//dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /yang dag par spong ②ba rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /dbang po rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /stobs rnams su dmyigs ②pa ma mchis so/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /bsam gtan rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /tshad myed pa rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so /rnam par thar pa brgyad du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgur dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed par dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /mngon par shes pa rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /snying rje chen por dmyigs pa ma mchis so sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 18—774

'bras bur dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bur dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bur dmyigs pa ma mchis so//dgra bcom pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /rang byang chub tu dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid du dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /byang chub tu dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sangs rgyas su dmyigs pa ma mchis so/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos su dmyigs pa ma mchis te①/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni dmyigs pa'i tshul du nye bar gnas pa ma lags so/ /de ci'i slad du zhe na/de ni 'di ltar gang gis dmigs par bgyi ba dang / gang la dmigs par bgyi ba dang / gang du dmyigs par bgyi ba de lta bu'i ngo bo nyid de la ma mchis so /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ /de de bzhin te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po des/ myi dmyigs pa'i tshul du/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la yun ring por spyod ②pas des byang chub kyang myi dmyigs na/ sangs rgyas lta ci smos/ sangs rgyas kyi chos lta'ang ci smos/ brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod kyi/ de ma lags pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa gzhan la myi spyod dam/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po ni ②pha rol tu phyin pa drug po kun la'ang / de myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis spyod de/des sbyin pa'ang myi dmyigs/ gtong ba'ang myi dmyigs/ len pa'ang myi dmyigs sobya/ /tshul khrims kyang myi dmyigs/ tshul khrims dang ldan pa'ang myi dmyigasadu/ tshul khrims ngan pa'ang myi dmyigs soyi/ /bzod pa'ang myi 18—775

dmyigs / bzod pa dang ldan pa'ang myi dmyigs/ gnod sems kyang myi dmyigs sol/ /brtson 'grus kyang myi dmyigs/ brtson 'grus dang ldan pa'ang myi dmyigs/ le lo yang myi dmyigs so/ /bsam gtan yang myi dmyigs/bsam gtan ②pa yang myi dmyigs/ 'khrug pa yang myi dmyigs so/ /shes rab kyang myi dmyigs/ shes rab dang ldan pa yang myi dmyigs/ shes rab 'chal pa yang myi dmyigs so/ /kau shi ka 'on kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/gzugs myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / tshor ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang /'du shes myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / 'du byed myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang /rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / myig myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang /rna ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sna myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / lce myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang ②/ lus myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / yid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / gzugs myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sgra myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / dri myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / ro myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang /reg myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / chos myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / myig gi rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rna ba'i rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sna'i rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang /lce'i rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / lus kyi rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / yid kyi rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang /myig gi 'dus te reg pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rna ba'i 'dus te reg pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang /lce'i 'dus te reg pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa myi 18—776

dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / yid kyi 'dus te reg pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang /myig gi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rna ba'i 'dus te ①reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sna'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi ②dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / lce'i 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / lus kyi 'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / yid kyi ②'dus te reg pa las byung ba'i tshor ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sa'i khams myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / chu'i khams myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / mye'i khams myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rlung gi khams myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang /nam mkha'i khams myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rnam par shes pa'i khams myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / ma rig byapa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / 'du byed myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rnam par shes pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang /mying dang gzugs myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / skye mched drug myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / reg pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / tshor ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sred pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / len pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang /srid ⑤pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / skye ba myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rga shi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul 18—777

dang / nang stong pa nyid mi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / phyi stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang /①stong pa nyid stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / chen po stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang /'dus byas stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid mi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / dbang po lnga myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / stobs lnga myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / byang chub kyi yan ②lag bdun myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / bsam gtan bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / tshad myed pa bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rnam par thar pa brgyad 18—778

myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa ①dgu myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa med pa myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / mngon par shes pa lnga myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad ②phyi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / so so yang dag par rig pa ②bzhi myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / snying rje chen po myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa ④brgyad myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang /dgra bcom pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rang byang chub myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / lam gyi rnam pa ⑤shes pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid myi dmyigs pa'i tshul dang / chos thams cad myi dmyigs pa'i tshul gyis/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ sbyin pa yongs su gtang ⑥ba'i sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la sngon du 'gro ba'o⑦/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po tshul khrims bsrung duba'i/ tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la sngon du 'gro ba'o⑨/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen potshu/ bzod ⑩pa yongs su bsgrub 8pa'i/ bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya 18—779

ba la sngon du 'gro ba'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brtson 'grus rtsom ①pa'i/ brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la sngon du 'gro ba'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po/ bsam gtan la snyoms par 'jug pa'i/ bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la sngon du 'gro ba'o/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po chos la rnam par lta ba'i/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yongs su rdzogs par bya ba la sngon du 'gro ba'o/ /kau shi ka 'di lta ste dper na/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi shing rnams lo ma sna tshogs can/ me tog sna tshogs can/ 'bras bu sna tshogs can/ dbyibs sna tshogs can/ chu zheng ②sna tshogs can du 'khod kyang / de dag gi grib ma la khyad par ram/ bye brag myi dmyigs te/ gzhan du na 1grib ma grib ma zhes bya ba'i grangs su 'gro bar zad do/ /kau shi ka de bzhin du pha rol tu phyin pa lnga/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pas yongs su zin pa ④thams cad mkhyen pa'i ye shes su yongs su bsngos pa rnams la yang khyad par ram/ bye brag myi dmyigs so/ /brgya byin gyis gsol pa / bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ yon tan thams cad yongs su rdzogs par bgyid pa'i slad du/ yon tan chen po dang ldan pa'o//bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ yon tan tshad ma mchis pa dang ldan pa'i slad du/ tshad ma mchis pa'i yon tan dang ldan pa'o/ /bcom ldan 'das shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni/ yon tan mu ma mchis pa dang ldan ⑤pa'i slad du/ yon tan kun tu mtha' yas pa dang ldan pa'o/ /bcom 18—780

ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris shing / glegs ①bam du bgyis te/ bcangs pa dang /mye tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang /na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis rim gror bgyis/ bkur ster bgyis/ phu dud du bgyis/mchod par ②bgyis te/ de nas gong du ji skad du bstan pa bzhin/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la tshul bzhin du yid la bgyis pa dang / rigs kyi bu'am / rigs kyi bu mo la las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di glegs ②bam du bgyis te/ gzhan ④stsal na/ de gnyis las ⑤gang gis ⑥bsod nams cher 'phel bar 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas na khyod nyid la drisal/ khyod kyis ji ltar bzod pa de ltar lung ston cig /kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la las/de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung mang po la/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang /spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan dusna tshogs kyis/ rim gror byas/bkur ster byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod pa ⑨byas pa dang / rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung yungs kur ⑨ gyi 'bru tsam zhig gzhan la byin te/ bgo bshar 0byas pa dang / rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la las/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung yungs mar gyi ⑫'bru tsam po de blangs te/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang /byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan 18—781
