dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis/ rim gror byas/ bkur stir byas/ phu dud du byas/ mchod par ①byas na/ de dag las gang gi khyabasod nams cher 'phel ba yin/ brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das bdag gis/ bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa'i don 'tshal te/ de la rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung mang po la/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang /phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis/ rim gror bgyis/ bkur stir bgyis/phu dud du bgyis/ mchod par dubagyis pa bas/ gang la las de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung yungs kur gyi 'bru tsam gzhan ④stsal na/ 'di ⑤ni de bas bsod nams cher 'phel lo/ /bcom ldan 'das de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas kyis kyang / don de nyid gzigs te/ rdo rje lta bu'i ting nge 'dzin la mnyam par bzhag nas/ rdo rje lta bu'i sku bshig ste/ sems can gyi ris na/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i ring bsrel gyis/ 'dul ba'i sems can ⑥mchis pa rnams kyi slad du/ thugs rje chen po bskyed ⑦de/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung du byin gyis brlabs so/ /bcom ldan 'das gang la las/ chung ngu na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sku gdung yungs kur gyi 'bru tsam la mchod pa sna tshogs kyis mchod pa ⑤bgyis na/ de dag thams cad kyang yophodage ba'i rtsa ba de'i mthar ma tu )thug par sdug bsngal (spremathar 'byin 8par 'gyur ro/ /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de de bzhin no/ /de de skyobazhin te/ kau shi ka rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu 18—782

mo la las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di glegs bam du byas te/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis/ rim gror byas/ bkur stir byas/ phu dud du byas/mchod par ①byas pa bas/ gang la las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris te / chos kyi dga' bas gzhan ②byin na/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams cher 'phel bar 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la las/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di ji skad du bstan ②pa bzhin du gzhan gyi drung du song ste/ bshad cing bstan pa dang /brjod cing bkrol ba dang / rnam par phye ste gsal bar byas na/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de ni/ rigs kyi bu bya'am rigs kyi bu ⑤mo snga ma dag pas/bsod nams cher 'phel te/ de ni ston pa yin ⑥par bsam mo/ /bla ma'i gnas mkhas pa tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa la la zhig yin par bsam mo /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 2shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid ston pa yin te'u/ ston pa ni gzhan shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa ni gzhan zhes bya ba myed kyi/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa nyid kyang ston pa/ ston pa nyid kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslabs ⑨pas/ 'das pa dang / ma byon pa dang /da ltar byung ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /18—783

mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /tshangs pa mtshungs par spyod pa de dag kyang / phyir myi ldog pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams las gud na myed de/ de dag kyang shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la bslabs shing ①/bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o②/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la bslabs shing ②/ nyan thos kyi theg pa pa rnams kyis kyang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams kyis kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslabs shing bya/ rang byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par dusangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'u'atshang rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par ⑦'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la bslabs shing du/ byang chub sems dpa'i ⑨skyon myed par zhugs so 'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka de bas na rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams la me tog dang / phreng ba 18—784

dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang /gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis mngon du rim gror bya bar 'dod pa dang / bkur ster bya bar ①'dod pa dang /phu dud du bya bar 'dod pa dang mchod par dubya bar 'dod pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di bris te/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang /byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis/ rim gror bya'o/ /bkur ster bya'o/ /phu dud du bya'o/ /mchod par bya'o/ /kau shi ka ngas don de nyid kyi dbang yang dag par mthong ste/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas nas 'di snyam ste/ gang zhig la bdag gis rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa bya ste/brten ducing rnam par spyad byapar bya snyam na/ kau shi ka de la ngas 'jig rten lha phyadang bcas pa/ bdud dang bcas pa/ tshangs pa dang bcas pa dang /dge sbyong dang bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgu dang / myi dang lha dang lha ma yin du bcas ⑥pa'i nang na nga khyadang 'dra ba'am/ lhag pa yang dag par rjes su ma mthong nas/ de la ngas 'di snyam du bsams tedu/ de ltar ⑨yin na bdag gis chos zhi ba bzang po gang bdag nyid kyis/ mngon par sangs rgyas pa de nyid la/ rim gro dang / bkur bsti dang / phu dud dang / mchod pa bya ste'u / brten cing rnam par spyod ⑨par bya'o/ /snyam du bsams sotso /kau shi ka chos de'ang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid yin te/ kau shi ka de ltar nga nyid kyang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin 18—785

pa 'di ①la/ rim gror byed/ bkur ster byed/ phu dud du byed/ mchod par byed de/ de ltar rim gro dang / bkur sti dang / phu dud dang /mchod pa ②byas shing ②rnam par spyod na/ kau shi ka rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'dod pas/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di la/ me tog dnge / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis/ rim gror bya ba dang / bkur stir bya ba dang / phu dud du bya ba dang / mchod par bya ba lta ci ⑤smos/ nyan thos kyi theg pa pa'i rigs kyi ④bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu'amatho/ rigs kyi bu mo de dag gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la/ me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang /phye ma dang / na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyis/ rim gror bya ba dang / bkur ster bya ba dang / phu dud du bya ba dang / mchod par bya ba lta ci smos/ de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las byung ba ni⑦/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams so/ /byang chub sems dpa' las byung ba ni/de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams so//de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las byung ba ni/ nyan thos dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams so/ /kau shi ka de lta bas dun/ byang chub sems dpa'i theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang ⑨/ rigs kyi 18—786

bu mo'am/ nyan thos kyi theg pa ①pa'am/ rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa'i rigs kyi bu dang / rigs ②kyi bu mos shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di nyid la me tog dang / phreng ba dang / spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang /na bza' dang / gdugs dang / rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan ①sna tshogs kyis/ rim gror bya'o/ /bkur stir bya'o/ /phu dud du bya'o//mchod par bya'o/ /de ltar de la slob pa'i rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo ④dag ni/ bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /nyan thos kyi theg pa pa rnams kyis kyang /dgra bcom pa nyid thob po/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams kyis kyang / rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob po /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa stong phrag brgya pa las/ le'u nyi shu gnyis sophya// //de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis/ lha'i dbang po brgya byin la bka' stsal pa/kau shi ka rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ gal te 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can de dag dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod par gyur na/kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de de'i rgyus/de'i dubasod nams mang du 'phel bar 'gyur ram/ gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas kyang la la zhig gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu 18—787

phyin pa 'di glegs bam klag pa'amal/ bri ba'am/ kha ton du bya ba'i phyir/gzhan ②byin na/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las/ zag pa myed pa'i chos gang la rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo slob cing / yang dag pa'i 0skyon myed par zhugs par gyur pa dang / 'jug pa dang 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur pa dang / 'thob pa dang / thob par 'gyur ba dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur pa dang / 'thob pa dang / thob par 'gyur ba dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur pa dang / 'thob pa dang / thob par 'gyur ba dang / dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur pa dang / 'thob pa dang / thob par 'gyur ba dang / rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams kyis/ rang sangs rgyas kyi byang chub thob par gyur pa dang / 'thob pa dang / thob par 'gyur ba dang / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yang dag par zhugs pa rnams kyis/ byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur pa dang / 'jug pa dang 'jug par 'gyur ba dang / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas pa dang / mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ba dang / mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ba de lta bu'i chos mang po rgya cher bstan to/ /kau shi ka zag pa myed pa'i chos rgya cher bstan pa de dag gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab 18—788

kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /① ②nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang /phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang /rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang /stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / du byarnam par thar pa brgyad ⑤dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa drug dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang /gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang /⑥ de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang /myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen po dang /⑦ 'di dag ni zag pa myed pa'i chos te/ de dag ni shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa las rgya cher bstan to/ /de dag la bslabs shing ④/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu 18—789

mo de khyadag kyang / bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka sems can gcig cig 37rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la bzhag 5snyen/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel gyibya/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can rnams dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod pas ni ma yin no/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / kau shi ka dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod pa'i sems can rnams ni/sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi ⑤skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig zhurten nas yongs su grol ba ma yin no/ /kau shi ka rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras ⑦bu la bkod pa'i sems can nidu/ sems can dmyal ba dang / byol song gi skye gnas dang / gshin rje'i 'jig rten nas yongs su grol ba'i phyir te/lan cig phyir 'ong rkyeba'i 'bras bu dang / phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu dang /dgra bcom pa nyid la bkod pa lta ci smos/ kau shi ka gang la las 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can rnamasathe sna/ rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la bkod pa dang /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la bkod pa dang / phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la bkod pa dang / dgra bcom pa nyid la bkod pa bas/ la la zhig gis sems can gcig cig phyarang byang chub la bzhag na/ 'di'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ / boko shi ka rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu la bkod pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan la la zhig gis sems can gcig cig bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bzhag 18—790

na / de'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi tshul rgyun myi 'chad pa'i don du zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /kau shi ka rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig gis 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la bkod pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am / rigs kyi bu mo gzhan la la zhig gis sems can gcig cig bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bzhag na/ 'di'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi tshul rgyun myi 'chad pa'i don du zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /kau shi ka rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu la bkod pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gzhan la la zhig gis sems can gcig cig bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bzhag na/ 'di'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/de ni sangs rgyas kyi tshul rgyun mi 'chad pa'i don du zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /kau shi ka rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad dgra bcom pa nyid la bkod pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gzhan la la zhig gis sems can gcig cig bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bzhag na/ 'di'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ de ni sangs rgyas kyi tshul rgyun myi 'chad pa'i don du zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ / 17 kau shi ka durigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad rang byang chub tu bkod pa bas/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis sems 18—791

can gcig cig ༅bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la bzhag na/'di'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ sems can gcig po bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu gzhog pa de ni/sangs rgyas kyi tshul rgyun mi gcad ②pa'i don du zhugs pa'i phyir ro/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka byang chub sems dpa' las byung ba ni/ rgyun tu zhugs pa dang / lan cig phyir 'ong ba dang / phyir myi 'ong ba dang / dgra bcom pa dang / rang sangs rgyas rnams so/ /kau shi ka byang chub sems dpa' las byung ba ni/ de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams so/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des na/ 'di ltar byang chub sems dpa' rnams kyang / mchod cing rim gror bya ba yin te/ 'jig rten lha dang bcas pa/ bdud dang bcas pa/ tshangs ②pa dang bcas pabya/dge sbyong dang ⑤bram zer bcas pa'i skye dgus me tog dang / phreng skyob dang /spos dang / byug pa dang / phye ma dang / gos ⑦dang / gdugs dang /rgyal mtshan dang / ba dan dang / sil snyan sna tshogs kyisadu/ rim gror bya ba dang / bkur stir bya ba dang / phu dud du bya ba yin par shes par bya'o/ /kau shi ka rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la la zhig gis/ 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can thams cad dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la bkod par ⑨gyur na/ kau shi ka de ci ④snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i 7rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ brgya byin gyis gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas kyang / rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis 18—792

shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa glegs ①bam bri (37ba'am/ klag zhupa'am/ kha ton du bya ba'i phyir gzhan ④byin na/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las/ zag pa myed pa'i chos rnams rgya cher bstan te/ de dag la bslabs shing snye/ rigs kyi bu'am ⑥rigs kyi bu mo dag yang dag pa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur to/ /'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to//'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob po/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams kyis/ rang sangs rgyas kyi 3byang chub thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang / yang dag pa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur to/ /'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par 3phosangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o༈sna//mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya khyabar 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka zag pa myed pa'i chos de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang /18—793

chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi ①mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ②ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang /dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang /⑧rnam par thar pa brgyad byadang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam phyepar thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa ༅skyed pa dang / mngon par shes pa drug dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi 2sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad dang / byams pa chen po dang /snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen po dag ste/sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad med pa gzhan dag kyang rgya ducher bstan to/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des kyang / rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang la las shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di glegs bam du byas te/ klag ⑨pa dang / bri ba dang /kha ton du bya ba'i phyir gzhan ⑩byin na/ de ni bsod nams ches mang du 'phel 18—794

bar ①shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las chos ②thams cad rgya cher bstan ①te/ de dag yod pas rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /sum cu ④ma gsum gyi lha rnams yod do/ /mtshe ma'i lha rnams yod do/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /'phrul dga'i lha rnams yod do/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs chen gyi lha rnams yod do/ /snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung snang gi skyilha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung dge'i ༅lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams yod do/ /che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung che'i ⑦lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi gdung ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /gya rnam dusnang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'og myin gyi lha rnams yod do/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /rnam 7shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do / /chung ⑨zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu 18—795

phyin pa yod do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /chen po stong pa nyid yod do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid yod do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yod do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa tshonyunyid yod do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid yod do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid yod do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yod do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams yod do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams yod do/ /dbang po rnams yod do/ /stobs rnams yod do/ /byang chub kyi 37yan lag rnams yod do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yod do / /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yod do/ /bsam gtan rnams yod do/ /tshad myed pa rnams yod do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams yod do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad yod do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yod do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa yod do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams yod do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams yod do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams yod do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams yod do/ /so so 18—796

yang dag par rig pa rnams yod do/ /snying rje chen po yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi ①chos ma 'dres pa rnams yod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong duba'i 'bras bu yod do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yod do//dgra bcom pa ①yod do/ /rang byang chub yod do/ /lam gyi rnam pa byashes pa nyid yod do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yod ⑤do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams skyoyod do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba ⑦rnams yod do/ /dgra bcom pa rnams yod do/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams yod do / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams yod do / /kau shi ka 'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can rnams lta zhog 3)gi/ kau shi ka gling bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo/ la las dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu bkod na/kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyind pa 'di'i 0glegs bam klag ⑩pa dang / bri ba dang / kha ton du 7bya ba'i phyir gzhan ⑩byin na/ bsod nams mches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las zag pa myed pa'i chos rnams rgya 8cher bstan 8te/ de dag la bslabs shing ⑩/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dag yang dag pa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur 18—797

to / /'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to①/ /'thob po/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /phyir myi 'ong khuba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams kyis/ rang byang chub thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur to/ /'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o / /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka zag pa myed pa'i chos de dag kyang / gang zhe na 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi ④pa rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang /phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa 18—798

stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / ①rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa drug dang /ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs ②bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad dang /byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang /btang snyoms chen po dag ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad myed pa gzhan zhudag kyang rgya cher bstan to/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des kyang / rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis④/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa glegs bam du bris shing / klag ⑤pa dang / bri ba dang / kha ton du bya ba'i phyir gzhan yibyin na/de bas ⑦'di'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel bar shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las chos thams cad rgya cher bstan te/ de dag yod pas/ rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams yod 18—799

dol/ /sum cu ①ma gsum gyi lha rnams yod do/ /mtshe ma'i lha rnams yod do/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /'phrul dga'i lha rnams yod do/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams yod do//tshangs chen gyi lha rnams yod do/ /snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung snang gi lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed ⑤snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /kun snang dang ba'i lha ①rnams yod do/ /dge ④ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung dge'i ②lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams yod do/ /che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung che'i ༅lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi gdung ba'i lha rnams yod do/ / shin tu ⑦mthong ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /gya rnam snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'og phyin gyi lha rnams yod do/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do//rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /chung duzad myed pa'i skye mched kyi lha rnams ⑨yod do/ /'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /bzod ⑩pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa yod do/ /nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /chen po stong pa nyid yod do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /18—800

'dus byas stong pa nyid yod do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yod do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid yod do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid yod do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yod do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams yod do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams yod do/ /dbang po rnams yod do/ /stobs rnams yod do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams yod do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yod do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yod do/ /bsam gtan rnams yod do/ /tshad myed pa rnams yod do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams yod do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad yod do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yod do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yod do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams yod do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams yod do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams yod do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams yod do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams yod do/ /①snying rje chen po ②yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa ④brgyad yod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yod do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yod do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid yod do/ /rang byang chub yod do/ /lam gyi rnam pa ①shes pa 18—801

nyid yod do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams yod do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba rnams yod do/ /dgra bcom pa rnams yod do/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams yod do / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams yod do / /kau shi ka gling chen po bzhi'i ①'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can rnams lta zhog gi/ /kau shi ka stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams gyur bu'i sems can/ ji snyed cig yod pa de dag /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la las dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu bkod na/ kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo/ de'i ②bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam / gsol pa bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo //bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas rigs kyi ②gu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i glegs bam klag ④pa dang / bri ba dang / kha ton du bya ba'i phyir gzhan ⑤byin na/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las zag pa myed pa'i chos rnams rgya khyacher bstan te/ de dag la bslabs shing ⑦/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dag yang dag pa'i skyon myed par ⑧zhugs par gyur to/ /'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro//rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro / /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to 'thob bo/ /18—802

thob par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi ②theg pa pa rnams kyis/ rang byang chub thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang / byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur to/ /'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub ②mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka zag pa myed pa'i chos de dag kyang / gang zhe na 'di lta ste/sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang /nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar bzhag pa ①bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga 18—803

dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / ①rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthard kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa drug ②dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad dang / byams pa chen po dang /snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen po dag ste/sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad myed pa gzhan dag kyang rgya zhucher bstan to/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des kyang / rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa glegs bam du bris shing / klag ④pa dang / bri ba dang /kha ton du bya ba'i phyir gzhan ⑤byin na/ de bas 'di'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel bar shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las/ chos thams cad rgya ༅cher bstan te/de dag yod pas rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do//rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /sum cu ⑦ma gsum gyi lha rnams yod do / /mtshe ma'i lha rnams yod do/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /'phrul dga'i lha rnams yod do/ /gzhan du'aphrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams yod do//tshangs ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /18—804

tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs chen gyi ②lha rnams yod do/ /snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung snang gi ②lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung dge'i ②lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed dge ④ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams yod do/ /che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung che'i lha ⑤rnams yod do/ /tshad med che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi gdung ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /gya rnam snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'og phyin gyi lha rnams yod do/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /rnam ༅shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do / /chung gzad myed pa'i skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /'du shes myed 'du shes myed nimyin skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /chen po stong pa nyid yod do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid yod do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yod do/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid yod do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid yod do/ /rang gi 18—805

mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yod do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams yod do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams yod do/ /dbang po rnams yod do/ /stobs rnams yod do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams yod do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yod do//'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yod do/ /bsam gtan rnams yod do/ /tshad myed pa rnams yod do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams yod do//rnam par thar pa brgyad yod do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yod do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yod do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams yod do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams yod do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams yod do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams yod do/ /so so yang dag par rig ①pa rnams yod do/ /snying rje chen po yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa dubargyad yod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yod do/ /phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yod do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid yod do/ /rang byang chub yod do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid yod do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams yod do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba rnams yod do/ /dgra bcom pa rnams yod do/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams yod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa 18—806

dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams yod do// //shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyin pa stong phrag brgya pa/ bam po nyi shu bdun ①pa / kau shi ka stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams byur bu ②lta zhog gi/ kau shi ka stong gnyis pa'i ③'jig rten gyi khams 'bring po'i sems can ji snyed pa de dag rigs kyi ④bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la las/ dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu bkod na / kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i tsoglegs bam ༅bri ba dang ⑦/ klag khyapa dang / kha ton du ⑨bya ba'i phyir gzhan ⑩byin na/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni ⑩'di ltar/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las / zag pa myed pa'i chos rnams rgya cher bstan te/ de dag la bslabs shing ⑫/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dag yang dag pa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur to/ /'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to8/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro//phyir mi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro//dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur rtsoto/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams kyis/ rang byang chub thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen 18—807

po rnams kyang / byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur to/ /'jug go /'jug par 'gyur ro/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka zag pa myed pa'i chos de dag kyang / gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang /'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong 7pa nyid dang /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / bsam gtan bzhi dang / tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang /① rnam par 18—808

thar ①pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ②dang / mngon par shes pa drug dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad dang / byams pa chen po dang /snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen po dag ste/sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad myed pa gzhan dag kyang rgya cher bstan to/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des kyang rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa laglegs bam du bris shing / klag ④pa dang / bri ⑤ba dang /kha ton du bya ba'i phyir gzhan ༅byin na/ de bas de'i khyabasod nams ches mang du 'phel bar shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las/ chos thams cad rgya cher bstan te/de dag yod pas rgyal rigs che 'ing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do//rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /sum cu nirtsa gsum gyi lha rnams yod do / /mtshe ma'i lha rnams yod do/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /'phrul dga'i lha rnams yod do/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams yod do//tshangs ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs chen gyi lha rnams yod do/ /snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung snang gi lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed snang 18—809

ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung dge'i ②lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams yod do/ /che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung che'i ②lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi gdung ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /gya rnam snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'og min gyi lha rnams yod do/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas ②skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do//chung bzad myed pa'i skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /'du shes myed 'du shes myed phyin skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yod do//brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /chen po stong pa nyid yod do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid yod ⑤do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yod do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid yod do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid yod do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid 18—810

stong pa nyid yod ①do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yod do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams yod do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams yod do/ /dbang po rnams yod do/ /stobs rnams yod do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams yod do//'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yod do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yod do/ /bsam gtan rnams yod do/ /tshad myed pa rnams yod do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams yod do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad yod do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms ②par 'jug pa dgu yod do/ /rnam par thar ②pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang mtshan ma myed pa dang smon pa myed pa yod dol/ /mngon par shes pa rnams yod do/ /ting nge ④'dzin rnams yod do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams yod do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams yod do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams yod do/ /snying rje chen po yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o brgyad yod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yod do//phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yod do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid yod do/ /rang byang chub yod do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid yod do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams yod do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba rnams yod do/ /dgra bcom pa rnams yod do/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams yod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams yod do/ /kau dushi ka stong gnyis pa du'ajig rten gyi khams 'bring po lta zhog gi /kau shi ka stong gsum gyi stong chen po'i 18—811

'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la las dge ba bcu'i las kyi lam la rab tu bkod na/ kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems / rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas ①rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i 6glegs bam bri ba dang / klag dupa dang / kha ton du bya ba'i phyir gzhan ④byin na/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na / kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las/ zag pa myed pa'i chos rnams rgya cher bstan te/ de dag la bslabs shing ⑤/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dag yang dag pa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur to/ /'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur thoto/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams kyis/ rang byang chub thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur to/ /'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang 18—812

rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka zag pa myed pa'i chos de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang /phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa ①nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / ②rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa skyed pa dang / mngon par shes pa drug dang /ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag 18—813

par rig pa bzhi ①dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa ②brgyad dang /byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang /btang dusnyoms chen po dag ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad myed pa gzhan dag kyang rgya cher bstan to/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des kyang / rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang gis shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa glegs bam du bris shing klag ༅pa dang / bri ba dang / kha ton du bya ba'i phyir gzhan ⑤byin na/ de bas 'di'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel bar shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di lasayi/chos thams cad rgya cher bstan te/ de dag yod pas rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams yod do / /sum cu ༅rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams yod do/ /mtshe ma'i lha rnams yod do/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /'phrul dga'i lha rnams yod do/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams yod do//tshangs chen gyi lha rnams yod do/ /snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung snang gi lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung dge'i ⑧lha rnams yod do/ /tshad med dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams yod do / /che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung che'i 0lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi che ba'i lha 18—814

rnams yod do/ /myi gdung ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /gya nom snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'og myin gyi lha rnams yod do/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /chung khyazad myed pa'i skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do//sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do / /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyind pa yod do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /chen po stong pa nyid yod do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid yod do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yod do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid yod do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid yod do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yod do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams yod do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams yod do/ /dbang po rnams yod do/ /stobs rnams yod do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams yod do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag ②brgyad pa yod do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yod do/ /bsam gtan 18—815

rnams yod do/ /tshad myed pa rnams yod do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams yod do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad yod do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yod do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma med pa dang / smon pa ༅skyed pa ②yod do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams yod do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams yod do/ /gzungs ②kyi sgo rnams yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams yod do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams yod do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams yod do/ /snying rje chen po yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa ba'o ④brgyad yod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yod do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yod do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid yod do/ /rang byang chub yod do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid yod do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams yod do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba rnams yod do/ /dgra bcom pa rnams yod do/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams yod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams yod do/ /kau shi ka phyogs bcu'i phyogs re re zhing 'jig rten gyi khams gaṅgā'i klung ⑤gi bye ma snyed dag na/ sems can ji snyed ⑨yod pa de dag rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la las/ dge ba khyabacu'i las kyi lam la rab tu bkod na/ kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus ⑧mang du 'phel lam/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /18—816

bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i 7glegs bam klag ②pa dang / bri ba dang / kha ton ②bya ba'i phyir gzhan ④byin na/bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu ⑤phyin pa 'di las/ zag pa myed pa'i chos rnams rgya cher bstan te/ de dag la bslabs shing ⑥/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dag yang dag pa'i 2skyon myed par zhugs par gyur to/ /'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to//'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams kyisadu/rang byang chub thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang / byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur to/ /'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas sol/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya ⑨bar 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka zag pa myed pa'i chos de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi 7pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu 18—817

phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang /don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang /stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / ①rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa drug dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang /gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang /myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen po dag ste/sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad myed pa gzhan dag kyang rgya cher bstan to/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des kyang / rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis/ shes 18—818

rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa glegs bam du bris shing / klag ①pa dang / bri ba dang / kha ton du bya ba'i phyir gzhan ②byin na/ de bas 'di'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel bar shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las/ chos thams cad rgya cher bstan ②te/ de dag yod pas rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /sum cu ④rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams yod do/ /mtshe ma'i lha rnams yod do/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /'phrul dga'i lha rnams yod do/ /gzhan 'phrul ⑤dbang byed kyi lha khyarnams yod do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs chen gyi lha rnams yod do/ /snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung snang gi lha rnams yod do/ /tshad med snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung dge'i ⑦lha rnams yod do/ /tshad med dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams yod do / /che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung che'i dulha rnams yod do/ /tshad med che ba'i 7lha rnams yod do/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi gdung ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /gya nom snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'og myin gyi lha rnams yod do/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /chung 0zad myed pa'i skye mched 18—819

kyi lha rnams yod do/ /'du shes myed 'du shes myed pyin skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /sbyin pa'i ①pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /chen po stong pa nyid yod do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid yod do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yod do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid yod do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid yod do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yod do / /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yod do/ /yang dag ②par spong ba rnams yod do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams yod do/ /dbang po rnams yod do//stobs rnams yod do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams yod do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yod do/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yod do/ /bsam gtan rnams yod do/ /tshad myed pa rnams yod do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams yod do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad yod do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yod do/ /rnam par thar ①pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ④yod do/ /187820

mngon par shes pa rnams yod do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams yod do/ /gzungs ①kyi sgo rnams yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams ②yod do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams yod do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams yod do②/ /snying rje chen po yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad yod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yod do//phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yod do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid yod do/ /rang byang chub yod do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid yod do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa ④rnams yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams yod do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba rnams yod do/ /dgra bcom pa rnams yod do/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams yod do/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams yod do/ /kau shi ka gzhan yang 'dzam bu'i gling gi ⑤phyi ji snyed pa de dag rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo la las bsam gtan ⑥bzhi la bkod de/ tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang / mngon par shes pa lnga la rab tu bkod na/kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis ⑦bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i duglegs bam klag ⑨pa dang / bri ba dang / kha ton du bya ba'i phyir gzhan ⑩byin na/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i 18—821

phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las zag pa myed pa'i chos rnams rgya cher bstan te/ de dag la bslabs shing ①/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dag yang dag pa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur to / /'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur lato/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams kyis/ rang byang chub thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang / byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur to/ /'jug go 'jug ⑤par 'gyur ro/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas so/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o / /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka zag ④pa myed pa'i chos de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu ⑤phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyen pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang / don dam pa stong pa nyid dang /'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' 18—822

las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma med pa stong pa nyid dang /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa ①nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang / stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa dang /'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / ②rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang / rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa drug dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang / gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang /dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen po dag ste/ sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad myed pa gzhan dag kyang rgya cher bstan to/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des kyang /rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa glegs bam du bris shing / klag ①pa dang / bri ba dang /④ kha ton du bya ba'i phyir gzhan dubyin na/ de bas 'di'i bsod nams ches mang du 'phel bar shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha 18—823

rol tu phyin pa 'di las chos thams cad rgya cher bstan te/ de dag yod pas/rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /bram ze'i ①rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /sum cu ②rtsa gsum gyi lha rnams yod do/ /mtshe ma'i lha rnams yod do/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /'phrul dga'i lha rnams yod do/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs chen gyi lha rnams yod do/ /snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung snang gi lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung dge'i ②lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams yod do/ /che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung che'i ④lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi gdung ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /gya rnam snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'og myin gyi lha rnams yod do/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do//chung ②zad myed pa'i skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /'du shes myed 'du shes myed myin skye mched ⑥kyi lha rnams yod do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyind pa yod do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yod dol/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol 18—824

tu phyin pa yod do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /chen po stong pa nyid yod do/ /don dam pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid yod do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yod do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dor ba med pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid yod do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid yod do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yod ①do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yod ②do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yod do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams yod do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams yod do/ /dbang po rnams yod do/ /stobs rnams yod do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams yod do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa khyayod dom/ /'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yod do/ /bsam gtan rnams yod do/ /tshad myed pa rnams yod do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams yod do/ /rnam par thar pa brgyad yod do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yod do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang /mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa ④yod do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams yod do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams yod do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams yod do//de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams yod do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams yod do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams yod do/ /snying rje chen po yod do/ /sangs 18—825

rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams yod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yod do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu yod do/ /dgra bcom pa nyid yod do/ /rang byang chub yod do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes pa nyid yod ①rdo/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnems yod do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba rnams yod do/ /dgra bcom pa rnams yod do/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams yod do / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams yod do / /kau shi ka ②'dzam bu'i gling gi sems can rnams lta zhog gi /kau shi ka gling chen po ②bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la las/ bsam gtan bzhi la bkod de/tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang /mngon par shes pa lnga la rab tu bkod na/ kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas rigs kyi bu'am/rigs kyi bu mo gang gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di'i glegs bam klag ④pa dang / bri ba dang / kha ton du bya ba'i phyir gzhan ⑤byin na/ bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las/ zag pa myed pa'i chos rnams rgya cher bstan te/ de dag la bslabs shing rjo/ rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo dag 18—826

yang dag pa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur to/ /'jug go 'jug par 'gyur rol/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo / /thob par 'gyur ro/ /phyir myi 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /dgra bcom pa nyid thob par gyur to/ / 7'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /rang sangs rgyas kyi theg pa pa rnams kyis①/rang byang chub ②thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams kyang / byang chub sems dpa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur to/ /'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /bla na myed pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu mngon par rdzogs par sangs rgyas sol/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya'o/ /mngon par rdzogs par 'tshang rgya bar 'gyur ro/ /kau shi ka zag pa myed pa'i chos de dag kyang gang zhe na/ 'di lta ste/ sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa dang / brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa dang / nang stong pa nyid dang / phyi stong pa nyid dang / phyi nang stong pa nyid dang / stong pa nyid stong pa nyid dang / chen po stong pa nyid dang /don dam pa stong pa nyid dang / 'dus byas stong pa nyid dang / 'dus ma byas stong pa nyid dang / mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid dang / thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid dang / dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid dang / rang bzhin stong pa nyid dang / chos thams cad stong pa nyid dang / rang gi mtshan 18—827

nyid stong pa nyid dang / myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid dang / ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid dang / dran pa nye bar gzhag pa bzhi dang / yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang / rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa bzhi dang / dbang po lnga dang /stobs lnga dang / byang chub kyi yan lag bdun dang / 'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa ①dang / 'phags pa'i bden pa bzhi dang / ②rnam par thar pa brgyad dang / mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu dang /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed ①pa dang / smon pa myed pa dang / mngon par shes pa drug dang / ting nge 'dzin thams cad dang /gzungs kyi sgo thams cad dang / de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs bcu dang / myi 'jigs pa bzhi dang / so so yang dag par rig pa bzhi dang / sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa brtswa brgyad dang / byams pa chen po dang / snying rje chen po dang / dga' ba chen po dang / btang snyoms chen po dag ste/sangs rgyas kyi chos tshad myed pa gzhan dag kyang / rgya cher bstan to/ /kau shi ka rnam grangs des kyang / rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa glegs bam du bris shing / klag ④pa dang / bri ba dang / kha ton du bya ba'i phyir gzhan ⑤byin na/ de bas 'di'i ⑥bsod nams ches mang du 'phel bar shes par bya'o/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las chos thams cad rgya cher bstan te/de dag yod pas rgyal rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /bram ze'i rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do/ /khyim bdag gi rigs che zhing mtho ba rnams yod do//18—828

rgyal chen bzhi'i ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /sum cu ①ma gsum gyi lha rnams yod do / /mtshe ma'i lha rnams yod do/ /dga' ldan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /'phrul dga'i ②lha rnams yod do/ /gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams yod do//tshangs ris kyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs lha nye phan gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs pa kun 'khor gyi lha rnams yod do/ /tshangs chen gyi lha rnams yod do/ /snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung snang gi lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /kun snang dang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung dge'i ②lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed dge ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /dge rgyas kyi lha rnams yod do/ /che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /chung che'i ④lha rnams yod do/ /tshad myed che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'bras bu che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi che ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /myi gdung ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /shin tu mthong ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /gya rnam snang ba'i lha rnams yod do/ /'og myin gyi lha rnams yod do/ /nam mkha' mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /rnam shes mtha' yas skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do//chung khyazad myed pa'i skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /'du ⑤shes myed 'du shes myed pyin skye mched kyi lha rnams yod do/ /sbyin pa'i pha rold tu phyind pa yod do//tshul khrims kyi pha rol tu phyind pa yod do/ /bzod pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa yod dol/ /brtson 'grus kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /bsam gtan gyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa yod do/ /nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi stong pa nyid yod do/ /phyi nang stong pa nyid yod do/ /stong pa nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /chen po stong pa nyid yod do/ /don dam pa stong 18—829

pa nyid yod do/ /'dus byas stong pa nyid yod do/ /'dus ma byas stong pa nyid yod do/ /mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /thog ma dang tha ma myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dor ba myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /rang bzhin stong pa nyid yod do/ /chos thams cad stong pa nyid yod ①do/ /rang gi mtshan nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /myi dmyigs pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po myed pa stong pa nyid yod do/ /ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /dngos po myed pa'i ngo bo nyid stong pa nyid yod do/ /dran pa nye bar gzhag pa rnams yod do/ /yang dag par spong ba rnams yod do/ /rdzu 'phrul gyi rkang pa rnams yod do/ /dbang po rnams yod do/ /stobs rnams yod do/ /byang chub kyi yan lag rnams yod do/ /'phags pa'i lam yan lag brgyad pa yod do//'phags pa'i bden pa rnams yod do/ /bsam gtan rnams yod do/ /tshad myed pa rnams yod do/ /gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa rnams yod do//rnam par thar pa brgyad yod do/ /mthar kyis gnas pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa dgu yod do/ /rnam par thar pa'i sgo stong pa nyid dang / mtshan ma myed pa dang / smon pa myed pa yod do/ /mngon par shes pa rnams yod do/ /ting nge 'dzin rnams ②yod do/ /gzungs kyi sgo rnams yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i stobs rnams yod do/ /myi 'jigs pa rnams yod do/ /so so yang dag par rig pa rnams yod do/ /snying rje chen po yod do/ /sangs rgyas kyi chos ma 'dres pa rnams yod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu yod do/ //ce) /༷/ 31( /bye( (11 1rdordo /lnga/ /ji/31( shāje( spu(1 1rdordolan ga ra nga ba 'bras bu da / / ra nga ba ②'bras bu da //dgra bcom pa nyid ④yod do/ /rang byang chub yod do/ /lam gyi rnam pa shes 187830

pa nyid yod do/ /rnam pa thams cad mkhyen pa nyid yod do/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa rnams yod do/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba rnams yod do/ /phyir myi 'ong ba rnams yod do/ /dgra bcom pa rnams yod do/ /rang sangs rgyas rnams yod do / /byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams yod do/ /de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams yod do / /kau shi ka gling chen po bzhi pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can rnams lta zhog gi /kau shi ka stong gi 'jig rten gyi khams kyi sems can ji snyed pa de dag rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo la las/ bsam gtan bzhi la bkod de①/tshad myed pa bzhi dang / gzugs myed pa'i snyoms par 'jug pa bzhi dang /mngon par shes pa lnga la rab tu bkod na/ kau shi ka de ji snyam du sems/rigs kyi bu'am rigs kyi bu mo de'i bsod nams de'i rgyus mang du 'phel lam/ /gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das mang ngo / /bde bar gshegs pa mang ngo / /bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ kau shi ka de bas rigs kyi bu ②'am rigs kyi bu mo gang gis/ shes rab kyi pha rold tu phyind pa 'di'i duglegs bam klag ④pa dang / bri ba dang / kha ton du bya ba'i phyir gzhan ⑤byin na/bsod nams ches mang du 'phel lo/ /de ci'i phyir zhe na/ kau shi ka de ni 'di ltar shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa 'di las zag pa myed pa'i chos rnams rgya cher bstan te/ de dag la bslabs shing ⑥/ rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo dag yang dag pa'i skyon myed par zhugs par gyur to/ /'jug go 'jug par 'gyur ro/ /rgyun tu zhugs pa'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /'thob bo/ /thob par 'gyur ro/ /lan cig phyir 'ong ba'i 'bras bu thob par gyur to/ /18—831
